title: Real Estate Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
Fraser & Co. (the Michelle Fraser Team) is a boutique real estate team in Pickering, Ontario, Canada, operating under RE/MAX Hallmark Fraser Group Realty. We represent sellers, buyers, landlords and tenants across Durham Region and the Greater Toronto Area. The team was founded by Michelle Fraser, who brings more than 25 years in the market.



We are hiring a Marketing VA to produce and publish our marketing. You will report to our Client Care Manager. This is a long-term role. Short-form video and graphic design are the core of the job, and you will also handle social publishing,
 campaigns and our marketing database. The scope will change as the business grows. We want someone who adapts quickly and is comfortable taking on new systems and tasks.



The Standard



Our marketing presents our clients' homes and our brokerage in public. Before you submit anything for review, check it against the approved property information and our brand guidelines.



Done right means:

- Every address, room count, feature, price and date checked against the property information we supply

- Photos and video that show the property as it really is: nothing added, removed or altered

- Our fonts, colours, templates and brokerage branding applied consistently

- Text placed where it reads clearly on a phone screen, with no spelling errors

- Only approved photos, footage and properly licensed music used

- Missing, conflicting or unclear information flagged right away, never guessed



Our team approves all content before it is published or sent. That review is a second check, not your first.



Schedule

- Monday to Friday, 6 paid hours a day, worked within 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time (30 hours a week)

- Additional hours may be needed during busy periods. They are agreed in advance and paid at your hourly rate.



Pay

- CAD $6 to $8 per hour, based on experience and portfolio

- Paid in Canadian dollars, twice a month. The USD figure above is approximate and moves with the exchange rate.

- Your rate is reviewed based on performance



What You Get

- A long-term position

- A direct manager, brand guidelines and templates to work from

- Room to grow as the role and the business expand



What You Will Do

- Edit listing reels, property highlights and sold announcements from supplied footage and photos

- Edit on-camera content, including talking-head, educational, testimonial and market update videos

- Create carousels, stories and listing graphics in Canva from our brand templates

- Design print materials, including direct mailers, postcards, posters and flyers, and prepare print-ready files to the printer's specifications

- Maintain the content calendar, write captions for approval, and schedule and publish approved posts on Instagram and

- Monitor comments and messages and route enquiries to the right team member

- Design and build
 campaigns in Flodesk, including newsletters, listing announcements, market updates and follow-up sequences. Draft subject lines and copy for approval, then test and schedule each send.

- Keep contact records, tags, lists and subscription preferences accurate in Follow Up Boss, and clean up duplicates and missing details

- Build audience segments, such as past clients, sphere, buyers, sellers and neighbourhoods, so each campaign reaches the right people

- Run database campaigns, such as past-client touchpoints, birthday and anniversary outreach, and just-listed and just-sold mailings, and prepare mailing lists for direct mail

- Track social and
 performance and report on what is working

- Keep photos, footage, templates and finished files organized in Google Drive, deliver editable project files with every final export, and track tasks in ClickUp

- Use AI tools inside our workflows, and check every output against the source

- Protect client information and follow our rules on what may be entered into AI tools

- Take on other marketing work as the needs of the business change

- You will be working with other team members to share these responsibilities 



Must Have

- A portfolio of vertical short-form videos you edited from raw footage, not only from templates

- Video editing in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar

- Practical Canva skills, including working within someone else's brand guidelines

- Hands-on experience with a CRM or
 marketing platform: campaigns, contact management and segmentation

- Experience scheduling and publishing on Instagram and

- Clear, accurate written English for captions,
s and on-screen text

- A computer suited to video editing, primary internet plus a backup connection, backup power, and a webcam and headset

- Full availability for the schedule above, with no other client work during your hours with us



Nice to Have

- Content for real estate, interior design, architecture or hospitality brands

- Editing drone footage, property walkthroughs and talking-head video

- Kinetic typography or simple motion graphics

- Follow Up Boss, Flodesk, ClickUp or Luxury Presence

- Regular use of AI tools in your work

- Experience with Canadian or North American clients



How to Apply



We review complete applications only. Following instructions exactly is part of this job. Applications are text only, so send links, not files.

- Use this subject line: Marketing VA | Your Full Name | Your Strongest Skill (Video, Design, Social or
)

- Start your message with the word COMPOSED.

- Resume (required): paste a link to your resume. Google Drive or Dropbox is fine. Set sharing to "Anyone with the link can view" and check that the link opens.

- Portfolio (required): paste links to at least two vertical videos you edited (ideally one on-camera or talking-head edit), one carousel or set of social graphics, and an
 campaign if you have one. Check that every link opens without requesting permission. Do not share anything that shows private client information.

- Answer the five questions below in your own words. Label your answers Q1 to Q5 and keep each one to 2 to 4 sentences.



Questions

Q1. For each portfolio link, what did you do? For example: edited from raw footage, designed from scratch, or adapted a template.

Q2. Which video, design, CRM,
 and AI tools do you use, and what work did you handle with each? Give one practical example of how AI improves your work.

Q3. How do you check a finished video or graphic before you submit it? Tell us about an error you caught or missed, and what you changed afterward.

Q4. Tell us about a time your role or priorities changed quickly. How did you adapt?

Q5. What other clients or jobs do you have right now, and how many hours a week do they take? Can you work 6 hours a day within 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time, Monday to Friday? What hourly rate within the posted range do you expect, and why? What is your earliest start date?



What Happens Next

Thank you to everyone who applies. We review every complete application, but only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: Real Estate Deal Closer
description:
Hi! We’re launching a real estate wholesaling business focused on houses, teardowns, and land for luxury developers. We’re looking for an experienced real estate pro to join us.



The process is simple:



Contact developers

Get their buy box (what they’re looking for)

Find a matching property

Contact a seller

Make an offer

Close the deal



Our AI does most of the heavy lifting. It researches properties, finds developer matches, drafts messages, and supports negotiation. Your job is to review its work, catch mistakes, use your judgment on which deals are worth pursuing, and help close them.



Pay



First month: $300 base (up to 15 hrs/week), plus bonuses. This is a paid trial, and the rate is the same for everyone. It gives you time to learn our system and market, and gives both of us a chance to see if it’s a good fit before committing long-term.

Closing bonuses: $100 to $1,000 per deal, plus extra bonuses for your first closing and for big deals.

After the first month, you can earn $2,000+ per month, depending on the deals you close.



Bonuses are paid once the company receives the assignment fee.



You’re a great fit if you have:



Experience in U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or dispositions

Real deals you’ve helped negotiate and close

Good English, organization, and follow-up

Bonus: experience with developers, land, teardowns, or luxury properties



Cold calling or appointment setting experience alone isn’t enough for this role.



To apply, please answer:



How many deals have you helped close, and what was your role?

What types of properties and markets have you worked in?

How do you d
 if a property is a good deal for a buyer?

Are you comfortable with the $300 first-month trial?

What hours and U.S. time zones can you work?



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Luxury Real Estate Acquisitions & Dispositions Specialist Closer - AI work 90% of time , you 10%
description:
We’re launching a real estate wholesaling business focused on houses, teardown opportunities, and land suited to luxury residential development.



Our software is about **90% complete**. The AI researches properties, identifies possible developer matches, drafts messages, and supports negotiation and closing. We’re looking for an experienced real estate professional to review its work, catch mistakes, assess whether opportunities are worthwhile, and help move strong deals forward.



## First month



The first month is a paid trial at a fixed rate of **$300 for the month**, plus any earned bonuses. This rate is not negotiable. The position is part-time, with a flexible schedule of **up to 15 hours per week** during the first month. We’ll agree on a schedule in advance.



If you close a high-value deal during your first month, you’ll receive a significant increase in your base pay during that month.



## Responsibilities



- Review AI research and suggested buyer matches for accuracy.

- Confirm that a property fits a developer’s criteria, including location, property type, lot size, budget, and timeline.

- Assess whether an opportunity is worth pursuing using comparable sales and potential assignment-fee calculations.

- Catch errors or gaps in the AI’s research, messages, negotiation support, or closing steps.

- Build developer relationships and keep their buying criteria current.

- Work with the AI to communicate and negotiate with sellers and buyers.

- Help coordinate promising deals through contracts, title or escrow, and closing.

- Keep deal information and next steps organized, and suggest improvements to the software and process.



## Compensation and bonuses



The first-month base pay is **$300 for the month**. Closing bonuses range from **$100 to $1,000**, depending on the deal.



Additional bonuses:



- **$500 first-closing bonus** if your first qualifying deal closes and the company receives its assignment fee within your first 60 calendar days.

- **$700 first-month bonus** if a qualifying deal you helped close during your first month brings the company an assignment fee of approximately $80,000 or more.

- **$1,000 monthly bonus** if you complete four or more qualifying closings in one calendar month. This is an incentive, not a quota.



Bonuses may be combined. A qualifying deal is one you meaningfully help manage. Deal ownership and any shared bonus arrangements will be agreed in advance. Bonuses are paid after the company receives cleared assignment-fee funds; a signed contract alone does not count as a closing.



### First-month earnings examples



- No closed deals: **$300 base pay**.

- One deal with a $40,000 assignment fee: $300 base + a closing bonus of $100–$1,000 = **$400–$1,300**.

- First qualifying deal closes in month one with an assignment fee of approximately $100,000 or more: $300 base + a closing bonus of $100–$1,000 + $500 first-closing bonus + $700 first-month bonus = **$1,600–$2,500**.



These examples do not include the significant base-pay increase that may apply after closing a high-value deal during the first month.



## Experience we’re looking for



- U.S. real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or dispositions experience.

- Seller negotiation experience and involvement in completed deals.

- Ability to review comparable sales, buyer fit, and assignment-fee assumptions.

- Strong English, reliable follow-up, and good organization.

- Comfortable sharing your judgment and feedback.

- A computer, reliable internet, and a quiet space for calls.



Experience with developers, land, teardown properties, or luxury markets is a plus. Cold calling or appointment-setting experience alone isn’t enough for this role.



## First-month focus



Learn the selected market, review and verify AI-generated research and matches, build developer relationships, and help negotiate and advance promising opportunities. We’ll focus on sound judgment, accurate reviews, follow-through, and pipeline progress.



## Questions for applicants



Please include answers to these questions with your application:



1. How many real estate deals have you personally helped close, and how many did you typically close in a month?

2. What was your role in those transactions, from finding or evaluating the property through negotiation and closing?

3. What types of properties and markets have you worked in? Have you worked with luxury properties, land, teardowns, or developers?

4. What was the largest assignment fee or deal value you handled, and what was your specific contribution?

5. How do you evaluate whether a property is a good deal and a genuine match for a buyer?

6. Tell us about a challenging negotiation. How did you handle it, and what was the outcome?

7. Which real estate tools or software have you used?

8. How would you review AI-generated property research, buyer matches, and outreach messages to catch mistakes before they affect a deal?

9. Are you comfortable with a fixed first-month base of $300, up to 15 hours per week, and the bonuses described above?

10. What hours are you available, and which U.S. markets or time zones can you support?

title: Inbound Lead Manager (Real Estate)
description:
We're Hiring: Inbound Lead Manager (Real Estate)



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time

Compensation: $1,760/month + $200 SPIFF per closed deal from leads you identify



About the Role



We are looking for a motivated and results-driven Inbound Lead Manager to handle incoming inquiries from homeowners interested in selling their properties.



You will serve as the first point of contact for potential sellers, conducting structured discovery calls to understand their situations, assess their motivation, and identify qualified opportunities. Your primary responsibility is to engage with homeowners, qualify their interest, and pass warm, motivated leads directly to the owner for closing.



This is a results-oriented role for someone who communicates confidently in English, asks the right questions, and understands the importance of accurate documentation and timely follow-up.



Key Responsibilities



Answer and manage inbound calls from homeowners interested in selling their properties.



Conduct structured discovery calls to understand seller motivation, property status, and readiness to sell.



Confirm listing status and ensure all relevant decision-makers are available for discussions.



Ask direct qualifying questions while keeping conversations natural and consultative.



Follow established call scripts and qualification guidelines.



Accurately document conversations, lead details, and call outcomes in the CRM.



Identify and hand off qualified, motivated sellers to the owner for closing.



Maintain organized records and follow established lead management processes.



Ensure timely follow-ups with prospective sellers when necessary.



Requirements



Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.



Experience in real estate, inbound sales, lead qualification, or a customer-facing phone role.



Strong verbal communication and active listening skills.



Comfortable asking direct questions to qualify potential sellers.



Excellent attention to detail and accurate CRM documentation skills.



Familiarity with real estate CRMs is an advantage; experience with Follow Up Boss is preferred.



Reliable, organized, self-motivated, and receptive to coaching.



Reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace.



Compensation & Schedule



Monthly Compensation: $1,760



Performance Incentive: $200 SPIFF for every closed deal attributed to a lead you identify.



Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM Eastern Time.



Employment Type: Full-Time, Remote.



How to Apply



If you enjoy speaking with people, have strong English communication skills, and have experience qualifying leads or working in real estate, we encourage you to apply.



Please submit your updated resume and a brief voice introduction highlighting your relevant experience, communication skills, and background in inbound lead management or sales.



We look forward to hearing from you!

description:
Join a growing U.S. real estate investment company and help us close more deals.



606 Home Buyers LLC is looking for an experienced Lead Manager who can confidently handle inbound and outbound seller leads. Your job is to prequalify motivated sellers, gather key property info, build rapport, and set quality appointments for acquisitions.



If you're results-driven, experienced in managing a pipeline, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to meet you.

6. Build rapport and create trust with sellers.

1. Strong spoken English and confidence on the phone.

2. Previous experience in real estate acquisitions, lead management, or phone-based sales (preferred).

3. Ability to follow scripts while also adapting naturally.

4. Comfortable working U.S. hours.

5. Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and clear audio.

6. Must be coachable, consistent, and results-driven.

title: Printer Technical Support Specialist
description:
About the Role

Barrister Global Services Network, Inc. is hiring a remote Printer Technical Support Specialist to guide our field Customer Engineers (CEs) through printer and copier repairs in real time. When a CE is on-site in front of a machine and cannot clear a fault, you are the expert they call.



This is not a general IT, helpdesk, or desktop/laptop support role. It is built for people with hands-on printer hardware repair experience.



• Location: Remote, open worldwide

• Employment type: Full-time

• Reports to: Technical Support Manager



Key Responsibilities

• Provide real-time phone and remote support to field CEs during printer diagnostics, repairs, part replacements, and installations.

• Troubleshoot hardware faults, print quality defects, error codes, paper jams, noise issues, and connectivity problems across multiple brands (HP, Lexmark, Xerox, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, and others).

• Use OEM service manuals to look up error codes, isolate failed components, and confirm the correct replacement parts.

• Walk CEs step by step through component-level work on fusers, drums, toner and imaging units, rollers, sensors, and feed assemblies.

• Act as the escalation point for complex or unresolved technical issues.

• Coordinate with manufacturers and vendors on advanced troubleshooting and case management.

• Monitor active service tickets so they are updated on time and properly documented.

• Keep repair reports, asset records, and case notes accurate.



Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of hands-on experience repairing printers, copiers, or multifunction devices, as a field technician, bench technician, or OEM technical support agent.

• Strong knowledge of printer hardware components and how they work together: fuser, drum, toner, transfer belt, rollers, sensors, and boards.

• Proven experience diagnosing hardware faults and replacing parts, not only software or driver issues.

• Able to read and apply OEM service manuals, error code tables, and parts catalogs.

• Hands-on experience with at least two major printer or copier brands.

• Experience supporting or working alongside field technicians or Customer Engineers.

• Familiar with ticketing systems and remote support tools.

• Clear, confident English, with the ability to guide someone through a repair under time pressure.

• Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, and a quiet workspace.



Preferred Qualifications

• Manufacturer certifications (HP, Lexmark, Xerox, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, or similar).

• Experience with Canon, Ricoh, Sharp, or Brother devices.

• Experience handling warranty claims or vendor escalations.



Please Note

Applicants whose experience is limited to general IT support, desktop or laptop support, or service desk work will not be considered. In your application, describe your printer and copier repair experience specifically: brands, models, and the repairs you performed.

title: Accounting Director ($5k/Month, PTO, 13th Month)
description:
Director of Client Accounting Services

Location: Remote, any country

Pay: $5,000 USD a month

Schedule: Full time. Core hours 9am to 2pm US Eastern on working days.

Reports to: Senior Director, Operations. Works directly with the owner.



You are the person other accountants bring the problem to. The difference nobody can find. The intercompany balance that will not tie. The client who has run out of patience. You fix it, and then someone above you, who often knows less about it than you do, d
 what happens next. This job gives you the decisions.



About Monterra

Monterra is a US accounting and tax firm. We have served business owners since 1991. Most of our clients own many businesses at once: groups with ten, twenty or more locations, each its own company, with numbers that have to tie across all of them.



Specialists. We have built the firm around owners of many businesses, so you spend your time on hard, interesting books instead of a long tail of one-off files.



Thirty-five years, and growing. New multi-location groups signed with us this fall, and not one client has left us in the past year.

We build our own tools. We wrote our own tax planning software, and we are rebuilding accounting the same way.



Remote by design. The whole firm works remotely. You will not be the one person on a different clock in an office that forgot you exist.



The role

We have more good clients than we have people to serve them, so we are hiring one person to run our whole client accounting department: the team, the standards, the final review and the numbers. There is no partner to wait on. When you see a better way to run it, you have the authority to change it. We are rebuilding the department around automation, and you d
 what gets automated and write the procedure the team follows once it works.



What you will own

The team: workloads, deadlines, coaching, hiring and performance for every accountant, in-house and outsourced

Final technical review of every close and financial statement before it reaches a client

One written method for every recurring task, plus a quality control program with monthly sample checks and an error log

Hours against benchmark and realization for every client, reported to leadership on one page each month

Onboarding each new client to a first clean close, and the client call when something goes wrong

The automation rebuild, starting with bank reconciliation matching, and a second-in-command who can run the department without you



Requirements

We judge what you have done, not how long you did it. You must be able to show us:

A team of accountants you ran for clients, and what changed because you ran it: closes that came in on time and errors that went down

Your record as the final reviewer on other accountants' work: closes and financial statements for multi-entity groups

A bank reconciliation you did yourself in the last twelve months

A procedure you wrote that a team actually follows

An outsourced or remote team you held to a standard, with numbers to prove it

English strong enough to explain a set of financial statements, or a mistake in them, to a US business owner on a live call



Nice to have

Franchise accounting, including 13-period calendars

Thomson Reuters Accounting CS

Accounting work you automated, and the hours it saved

You do not need a degree, a licence, a particular title or a set number of years.



Pay and perks

$6,000 to $7,000 USD a month, paid in US dollars wherever you live

Annual bonus tied to your team's performance.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, in any country.

Run your own day outside the core hours.

A short line to the top. Your proposals go to the Senior Director, Operations and the owner, and you get an answer.

Your own bench. You choose and develop the person who will be your number two.

Paid time off. Two weeks to start, plus all US holidays and the public holidays where you live.



Your first year

First 30 days: You learn every client and meet every accountant. You start on the bank reconciliations for our largest client group.

By day 90: The buck stops with you on every client close and you run the weekly workload review. Your review standard and onboarding checklists are in use. Your first monthly report is sent.

By month 6: Every recurring task has one written method. Monthly quality checks are running. Our outsourced partner is held to the hours and quality we agreed, with data.

By month 9: You own the department. At least one automated workflow is live under your procedures. Someone on your team can run the department for two weeks while you are away.



How we hire

We do not screen on job titles or count your years. We ask what you did, with numbers, and who can confirm it.

Application. About 35 minutes. Three short accounting tests and questions about your results. No cover letter.

Work test one. A month-end close review, a bank reconciliation and a written procedure, built from the work you would own here. About 2.5 hours.

Work test two. Your first weeks in the seat, in one data pack. About 2.5 hours.

Interview with the owner. We contact your references after the interview, not before.

Every application gets a reply. You will never wait weeks in silence wondering whether anyone read your work.



How to apply

Apply here: 
. There is one seat.

 outreach.

title: Full-Charge Bookkeeper
description:
We are a US staffing company with offices in several states, and we’re hiring a full-time bookkeeper to own our books from start to finish. You’ll work directly with our CEO and operations team.



This is a full-time night shift role: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday. It is not part-time, flexible, or a side job.



Salary: $1,400 USD per month. This rate is fixed and non-negotiable. Please only apply if this rate works for you.



What You Will Do



Pay vendor invoices, rent, utilities and ACH payments

Run the AR aging report daily and follow up with customers on overdue invoices

Reconcile bank and credit card accounts every month

Post weekly payroll journal entries and manage bank feeds in QuickBooks Online

Prepare the monthly P&L and Balance Sheet

Build weekly reports in Excel (gross profit, invoice aging, commissions)

Spot errors and discrepancies, and fix them before they become problems



You Must Have



3+ years of full-cycle bookkeeping for US companies. Full cycle means you have personally handled AP, AR, bank and card reconciliations, journal entries and month-end close, not just one part of it.

Daily, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience

Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP, pivot tables)

Clear written English for
ing US customers about payments

Ability to work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern consistently

Reliable internet and backup power



Nice to Have



Staffing or temp agency bookkeeping experience

TempWorks or a similar staffing system

QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification



This Role Is NOT for You If



Your experience is mainly Philippine (non-US) bookkeeping, tax filing or audit

You have only done data entry or one part of the cycle (AP only, AR only)

You are looking for part-time or flexible hours

You are expecting more than $1,400 per month



How to Apply



1. Attach your resume to your application. If your resume is not attached, your application will be unsuccessful and will not be reviewed.

2. Use the subject line: “US Bookkeeper - [Your Full Name]”

3. In 3 to 5 sentences, name the US companies you have done full-cycle bookkeeping for and describe your monthly tasks.

4. Confirm in your message that you accept the $1,400/month rate.



Applications that do not follow these steps will not be considered.

title: Copywriter (Full-Time, Flexible Hours, Training Provided)
description:
FULL-TIME COPYWRITER FOR AN AMAZON RESELLING COACH (TRAINING PROVIDED)



Hi, I'm Saykho.



I run an online coaching business that teaches everyday people how to resell products on Amazon. I started in 2020 reselling on eBay, moved to Amazon, and have done over $5,000,000 in lifetime Amazon sales. Today I coach students, run live trainings,
 my list, and post content on Instagram, TikTok,
 and YouTube.



I'm hiring one full-time copywriter to write with me. You will write in my voice, to my audience, every day. All training is provided on the job. I care more about how you write and how you take feedback than about your resume.



**WHAT YOU WILL WRITE**



1.
s. Daily nurture
s, reminders for live trainings, launch sequences and promotions. Short, plain, story-driven, one call to action.



2. Short-form video scripts for Instagram Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts. 30 to 90 seconds each. Hook, setup, payoff, call to action. I film them, you write them.



3. Text-based Instagram Stories. Daily story sets (3 to 6 frames) built in Canva from templates I give you. Simple text on clean backgrounds, one message per frame, one prompt to DM or comment.



You will also help repurpose content across formats (a live training becomes an
, an
 becomes a script, a script becomes a story set) and keep our swipe file of winning hooks and subject lines organized.



HOW WE WORK



- Training is provided. You get my copywriting rules, my swipe file, recordings of my trainings, and feedback on every draft for your first 30 days. You do not need to know Amazon reselling to apply. You do need to be curious enough to learn it.

- Tools: Google Docs, Canva, Kit (our
 platform) and a team chat. If you have not used ConvertKit (Now named Kit), I will show you.

- Flexible hours. This is a 40-hour-per-week role, but you choose when you work, as long as deadlines are hit and you are reachable for a short daily check-in window we agree on together.

- Hourly pay with a simple time tracker.

- Long-term. I am hiring one person I can keep for years, not a project.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- Excellent written English. Conversational American English.

- You can write in someone else's voice and follow a style guide to the letter.

- You understand, or want to master, direct response copy: hooks, stories, specifics, one clear call to action.

- You know Canva basics (text, layouts, templates) or can learn them in a week.

- You are organized, meet deadlines without reminders, and take edits without taking them personally.

- Reliable internet, a working computer, and a quiet place to work.



Nice to have, not required: experience writing
s for a coach, creator or online course; short-form scripting; familiarity with how Instagram Stories and Reels work.



PAY AND BENEFITS



- Starting pay: $3 to $5 per hour USD, depending on experience. That is roughly $480 to $800 per month at 160 hours.

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, flexible schedule.

- 13th month pay.

- Paid biweekly via Wise or PayPal.

- Raises based on performance.

- Paid training from day one.



HOW TO APPLY



Read this part carefully. I use it to see who pays attention.



1. Start your application with the word RAGOON as the first word on the subject line.



2. Answer these three questions in 1 to 3 sentences each:

   a) What is one
, ad or video that made you buy something, and why did it work on you?

   b) Describe your work setup and the hours you prefer to work (Philippine time).

   c) What is your experience with Canva, from zero to daily user?



3. Share 2 writing samples (links or pasted text).
s, scripts, captions, posts, anything you wrote yourself. If you have none, skip this and let the test speak for you.



4. Do this short test (15 to 20 minutes):

   Write one
 of 120 to 180 words to people who want to start reselling on Amazon but believe "Amazon is too saturated." Use this fact: Amazon does about $1.96 billion in sales every single day, and around 60% of that comes from independent sellers. End with one call to action to join a free live training.

   Then write 3 different opening hooks (one line each) for a 30-second video on the same topic.



5. Do not use em dashes anywhere in your application. Our house style never uses them.



6. Tell me your expected hourly rate within the $3 to $5 range.



Thanks you. I look forward to speaking soon.



Saykho

title: Powersports Marketing Manager
description:
Full-Time Marketing Manager | Shopify, Google Ads & Meta Ads

We’re a growing U.S. powersports company behind KICKIN Bikes and a regional distributor of RFN electric dirt bikes. We’re looking for a hands-on marketing manager who can turn ideas into finished campaigns, help grow our dealer network, and get more customers interested in our bikes.

We already have products, inventory, brand assets and marketing tools. We need someone who can put them to work consistently. Several products across our gas and electric bike lines still need dedicated campaigns, giving you plenty of opportunities to make an impact.

The role

You’ll work directly with the owner to plan and execute marketing. This is not a social-media-only position or a role where you simply assign work to other people. You should be comfortable writing copy, creating designs, building campaigns, improving Shopify pages and managing paid ads yourself.

Your most important contribution will be taking marketing work off the owner’s plate while bringing expertise, ideas and reliable execution.

What you’ll do

* Plan, build and improve Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns, including creative, targeting, tracking and performance reporting.

* Develop campaigns for products that currently have little or no marketing, especially across the KICKIN gas and EXV electric bike ranges.

* Write clear, persuasive ad copy,
s, product-page copy and blog content.

* Create polished marketing graphics that follow each brand’s guidelines.

* Build and improve Shopify product pages and campaign landing pages.

* Develop
 campaigns and automated flows, using our existing tools and approved workflows.

* Prepare dealer-facing promotions and materials dealers can use with their customers.

* Explore and test Reddit advertising as part of the marketing plan.

* Bring forward useful campaign ideas and identify opportunities without waiting for every task to be assigned.

* Support approved dealer outreach campaigns when appropriate.

* Check your work before launch and report what is working, what isn’t, and what you recommend changing.

How we’ll work together

Expect two or three calls with the owner each week, plus regular daily messages. The goal is to spend roughly 5% of your working time getting direction and asking questions, generally no more than 10%, with the rest focused on execution.

You should be able to take a rough brief or voice note, identify what’s missing, and bring back finished work for review. The owner retains final approval of marketing plans, copy and creatives. You will work within approved budgets and publishing permissions.

Required experience

* Hands-on Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign management.

* Shopify experience.

* Strong English copywriting and communication skills.

* Design skills and the ability to follow established brand guidelines.

* Ability to interpret campaign results and explain your decisions clearly.

* Strong organization, attention to detail and follow-through.

* Ability to work independently while staying responsive and collaborative.

Helpful experience

Klaviyo or similar
 platforms, Reddit Ads, dealer or wholesale marketing, powersports, and using AI tools to improve productivity without sacrificing accuracy or quality.

What success looks like

During your first 90 days, we want to see:

* A clear marketing plan with prioritized products and campaigns.

* Consistent delivery of quality work with fewer revisions and less owner involvement.

* Campaigns built and launched within agreed approvals and budgets.

* Reliable tracking and straightforward reports that connect activity to results.

* A measurable reduction in the owner’s marketing workload.

Hours and compensation

* Remote, approximately 8 hours per day.

* Working days: Monday-Friday

* Required overlap with U.S. Mountain Time: Some - will have meetings 2-3 times/week at both 9am mountain time and 11am mountain time.

* Compensation: $5+/hour



How to apply

Please include:

1. A short explanation of why you fit this hands-on role.

2. Two or three Google or Meta campaigns you personally worked on. Explain your role, budget, timeframe, results and what you changed to improve performance. Redact confidential information.

3. Examples of your copywriting, design and Shopify work.

4. Your experience with
 marketing and Reddit Ads, if any.

5. Your availability, preferred working hours and expected compensation.

Be specific about what you personally created or managed. Explain how results were measured, rather than providing screenshots without context.

Finalists may be invited to complete a short, paid practical exercise using a product brief: a campaign outline, sample ad or
, and a simple measurement plan.

title: Quality Manager | Supplier Quality & Product Quality | E-commerce
description:
At Olvy, we're looking for a hands-on, analytical and results-driven Quality Manager to take ownership of product quality across our supply chain.



We sell physical consumer products across European marketplaces, including Amazon and 
, and work with international manufacturers and suppliers.



As we continue to grow, we want to take our quality standards to the next level.



We're not looking for someone who simply checks inspection reports, forwards complaints to suppliers, or maintains spreadsheets.



We're looking for someone who digs deeper, identifies the real root cause, challenges suppliers and makes sure the same quality problem doesn't happen twice.



If you enjoy solving technical product problems, working with data and driving real improvements, this could be a great fit.





WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



1. SOLVE QUALITY PROBLEMS AT THE ROOT CAUSE



- Analyze product defects, customer complaints, returns and inspection failures.

- Identify recurring quality issues using data and root cause analysis.

- Lead Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and 8D investigations.

- Work directly with suppliers to implement effective, long-term solutions.

- Verify that corrective actions actually work and prevent recurring defects.



Your job isn't finished when a supplier promises to fix a problem. It's finished when the problem is proven to be solved.





2. IMPROVE PRODUCT INSPECTIONS & QUALITY STANDARDS



- Define clear, measurable quality acceptance criteria.

- Classify defects as Critical, Major or Minor.

- Determine appropriate AQL levels and inspection requirements.

- Review pre-shipment inspection reports and evaluate shipment quality.

- Identify weaknesses in inspection procedures and improve them.

- Make quality-based shipment release recommendations and decisions within agreed procedures.





3. DRIVE SUPPLIER QUALITY IMPROVEMENTS



- Hold manufacturers accountable for product quality.

- Request, review and challenge supplier 8D reports and CAPAs.

- Monitor supplier quality performance and identify recurring issues.

- Coordinate supplier audits and follow up on improvement plans.

- Build strong, professional relationships with suppliers while maintaining high quality standards.



You'll work closely with manufacturers, including suppliers in China.





4. TURN QUALITY DATA INTO ACTION



We have access to valuable product quality information from multiple sources.



Your responsibility is to turn that information into meaningful improvements.



You'll work with data from platforms such as:



- Amazon and 

- Zendesk

- Airtable

- Excel

- Product inspections and supplier reports



You'll identify defect trends, recurring customer complaints, supplier performance issues and opportunities to reduce the cost of poor quality.



We value someone who can spot patterns, investigate problems and turn findings into concrete actions.





5. MANAGE PRODUCT COMPLIANCE



- Review product compliance documentation for European markets.

- Check relevant CE documentation, RoHS, EPR, SDS, food contact documents and test reports.

- Identify missing, incorrect or insufficient documentation.

- Support compliance checks for new products before purchasing approval.

- Ensure product quality and compliance requirements are properly documented.





6. BUILD BETTER QUALITY PROCESSES



We don't want unnecessary bureaucracy.



We want simple, effective processes that help us prevent problems and continuously improve.



You'll help develop and improve our quality management approach using methods such as:



- Root Cause Analysis

- CAPA and 8D

- AQL inspections

- Lean Six Sigma

- ISO 9001 principles

- Supplier quality scorecards





WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



MUST-HAVE QUALIFICATIONS



- At least 3 years of experience in Quality Management, Supplier Quality or Quality Engineering.

- Experience working with physical consumer products, preferably electronics, appliances or similar products.

- Proven experience conducting Root Cause Analysis and managing CAPAs.

- Hands-on experience with 8D or similar structured problem-solving methods.

- Experience working directly with manufacturers and suppliers.

- Familiarity with Chinese manufacturers or Asian production environments.

- Knowledge of AQL inspections and defect classification.

- Ability to translate product specifications into measurable inspection criteria.

- Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel capabilities.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- A proactive, independent and detail-oriented working style.





NICE TO HAVE



- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification.

- ISO 9001 knowledge.

- Experience with EU product compliance requirements.

- Experience working with third-party inspection companies.

- Experience conducting supplier audits in China.

- Familiarity with Airtable.

- Mandarin language skills.





WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?



You don't accept "we will improve next time" as a sufficient supplier response.



You ask why a defect occurred, how it escaped detection, what will change in the production process and how the supplier will prove the solution works.



You are comfortable challenging suppliers, interpreting technical information, analyzing large datasets and taking ownership of problems.



You are practical, structured and persistent.



Most importantly, you care about preventing quality problems, not just reporting them.





WHAT WE OFFER



- A full-time, long-term remote opportunity with a growing European e-commerce company.

- Direct collaboration with our Operations and Supply Chain teams.

- Real ownership and the opportunity to shape our quality management processes.

- International exposure to European markets and Asian manufacturing.

- A role where your improvements have a direct impact on product quality and customer satisfaction.

- Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications.





HOW TO APPLY



We value practical experience and problem-solving ability more than impressive job titles.



To apply, please send:



1. Your CV or resume.



2. A short introduction about your experience with supplier and product quality.



3. ONE REAL EXAMPLE of a recurring product quality problem you solved. Please explain:

   - What was the problem?

   - How did you identify the root cause?

   - What corrective actions were implemented?

   - How did you verify the problem was permanently resolved?



4. Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



5. Your availability to start.





IMPORTANT:



Please start your application with the words "Quality Starts at the Root" so we know you've read the full job description.



We are looking for someone who wants to take real ownership, solve challenging problems and help us build a stronger quality operation.



If that's you, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Technical Account Engineer (MSP) – Infrastructure, Cloud & Projects
description:

Are you an experienced IT systems engineer or solutions consultant who thrives at the intersection of architecture, project execution, and strategic client advisory? If you enjoy translating complex business challenges into resilient cloud and infrastructure designs, driving end-to-end project cutovers, and serving as the trusted technical authority for business leaders, this role was built for you.



We bridge the gap between high-level consulting and real-world engineering. As our Technical Account Engineer (MSP), you will oversee the full lifecycle of client technology: from initial discovery, solution design, and SOW scoping, to hands-on project delivery, ongoing infrastructure roadmap reviews, and high-level escalation engineering. We back our team with direct leadership mentorship, company-paid certifications, and a culture that values engineering craftsmanship and ownership.

* Health Reviews & Roadmapping: Conduct annual IT assessments, evaluating cloud security posture, hardware lifecycles, system performance, and more.

* Proactive Gap Remediation: Analyze recurring operational tickets to diagnose chronic IT issues, proposing technical solutions rather than temporary workarounds.

* Escalated Consultation: Advise clients and support teammates through urgent technical dilemmas, compliance changes, disaster scenarios, and business expansion needs.

.

* Remediation Plans: Engineer and deploy long-term technical remediation plans for root-cause issues uncovered during major i
.

What We Are Looking For



* Relevant Experience: 3 to 5+ years of hands-on systems administration, technical account management, or solutions engineering experience, with solid exposure to Managed Service Provider (MSP) environments.

* Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure: Deep working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, Azure Virtual Desktop/IaaS, Windows Server environments, Active Directory, DNS/DHCP, and Group Policy.

* Networking & Security Acumen: Proven competency configuring firewalls (Fortinet, SonicWall, Ubiquiti, or Meraki), VLANs, site-to-site VPNs, endpoint detection and response (EDR), and backup/disaster recovery systems (Datto, Veeam, Acronis).

* Executive-Level Communication: Flawless verbal and written English communication skills, with an ability to clearly convey technical risk and value to executive business owners and IT stakeholders alike.

* Remote Reliability: Dedicated home office located in NCR or nearby, equipped with high-speed, redundant internet connections and secondary power backup.

* Schedule & Setup: Comfortable working US business hours (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST / overnight in the Philippines) from a dedicated home office with reliable high-speed internet and power backup.



Nice to Have:



* Prior experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment or using RMM/PSA tools.

* Hands-on exposure to firewall configurations (Ubiquiti, Cisco, Fortinet), VLANs, VPNs, or tenant-to-tenant migrations.

* Foundational industry certifications (CompTIA Network+/Security+, Microsoft Certified: Fundamentals / Azure Administrator, or CCNA).

* Familiarity with centralized documentation platforms.



Why Join Cloudavize?



Work directly with US business leaders and help implement practical, high-impact technology solutions.

* Combine client-facing technical advisory with hands-on infrastructure engineering projects.

* Collaborate with a supportive US and global team of account managers, project specialists, and service delivery engineers.

* Clear career development pathways toward Senior Technical Account Management, Solutions Architecture, or Engineering Leadership.



What Sets Us Apart?



* We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally:

* Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

* Continuous Learning: We invest in your professional growth with company-paid certifications and technical training.

* Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input, respects your expertise, and supports your success.

title: Digital Nail Art Designer

REQUIREMENTS

- Ability to learn new applications quickly.

APP ACCESS

You do not need to be located in a country where our app is publicly available.



Training and instructions will be provided for using our nail design builder and organizing completed designs.



INITIAL PROJECT

COMPENSATION AND CONTRACT TERMS

HOW TO APPLY

title: Flipboard Virtual Assistant
description:
What is Flipboard?

Flipboard is a free app and website that collects news and articles from across the internet. Users save articles into “magazines,” which are collections built around one topic. Other people follow these magazines to read new content. When you add someone else’s article to a magazine, this is called “flipping” or “reflipping” it.



If you have used
, Pinterest, or Instagram, you will find Flipboard easy to learn. It is simply another social media tool. I will give you full training before you start, so you do not need Flipboard experience.



What you will do

Your only task is to reflip good, relevant articles into my Flipboard magazines. For each session, you will:

Find suitable articles on Flipboard

Read the article titles and check their popularity

Choose the correct magazine for each article

Reflip the articles into those magazines



You will not write content, design graphics, or manage other social media accounts.



Schedule

This work must happen at three set times each day. All times are Paris time (France):

6:00 am

10:00 am

1:30 pm

Each session takes about 20 minutes. I need someone who can work at these times every day. Please check what these times are in your own time zone before you apply. Note that France changes its clocks for summer time in late March and late October.



What I need from you

Very good written and reading English. You must understand an article well enough to d
 if it suits my readers and which magazine it belongs in.

Good judgment about quality. My readers are older, educated, and mostly American. The content must be trustworthy and suitable for them.

Reliability. The set times are important, so you must be on time for every session.

Attention to detail.

Basic experience with social media or online research.

A reliable internet connection.



What I offer

Full training on Flipboard and my magazines

Long-term, steady work

A friendly, supportive working relationship



How to apply

Please send a short message that tells me:

Your experience with social media or online research

Your time zone, and confirmation that you can work at the three times above

One article from any news website that you think would interest a reader aged 45 to 75, and why

Please type FLIPBOARD in the subject line in capital letters



This is a great fit if you’re reliable and want a long-term, low-stress role with room to grow.

You will turn raw phone footage from our in-house team and content creators into organic TikToks and Reels, product videos for Amazon, Chewy, and TikTok Shop, and paid social and Amazon Sponsored Brands video ads.



You won’t just be cutting clips together. You will add creative flair, dynamic masking, kinetic transitions, and sound design to make simple clips feel clever and fun. You should be fluent in TikTok and IG culture, native trend formats, and creative visual editing tricks.



We work AI-first. You should already use AI features in your editing tools (for example, DaVinci Resolve Magic Mask or CapCut auto cutout) to work faster without lowering quality.



Pay: USD 1,500 to 2,000 per month, depending on experience

Schedule: 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM PST

Reports to: Creative Director. You will work day to day with our Social Media Manager and other marketing managers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Organic Social Video (about 20 hours per week)



Edit 9:16 vertical videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels using raw footage from our in-house social team and content creators.

Apply creative visual effects, including dynamic rotoscoping and masking (sticker peel effects, freeze-frame cutouts, object pop-ins), seamless jump cuts, disappearing and appearing object tricks, match cuts, native collage, paper tear, 2D sticker animations, and seamless loops built for replay value.

Time cuts, transitions, text animations, and effects precisely to the beat of the music.

Design on-screen text with a refined eye: choose and pair fonts, set clear hierarchy and spacing, keep text within platform safe zones, and animate it so it looks polished and premium, not template-based.

Add trending audio licensed for business accounts, sound effects, animated captions, and platform-native text styles.

Bring your own ideas for hooks, pacing, and trend formats instead of only assembling footage.



Marketplace Video (about 10 hours per week)



Create product videos for Amazon (listing and A+ Content), Chewy, and other channels.

Adapt content to each platform’s formats, including 16:9, 1:1, and 9:16.

Follow each retailer’s content guidelines, with clear product benefits and demonstrations.



Paid Ads (about 15 hours per week)



Edit video ads for Meta, TikTok, and Amazon Sponsored Brands.

Produce multiple hook and format variations of each concept for testing.



AI Workflow



Use AI tools throughout your workflow to speed up turnaround, such as AI masking and rotoscoping, auto captions, beat detection, and rough cut assembly, while keeping full creative control of the final edit.

Generate and edit video and visual assets with AI tools such as Seedance, Higgsfield, and Claude, and blend them with live footage.



Across All Work



Manage a steady weekly queue of requests from the Creative Director, Social Media Manager, and marketing managers.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

title: Data Engineer
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Data Engineer builds and runs the pipelines that feed Ally's data platform, so the rest of the company can trust and use its data. You'll join a new, growing Data Operations team, reporting to the Director of Data Operations and supporting teams across the business that depend on data from our CRM, TMS and product systems.

The role works primarily in Databricks, owning ingestion, transformations, pipeline monitoring and reliability. You'll be expected to move quickly while keeping strong engineering habits: version control, code review, testing and documentation. Clear written English and comfort working async with a US-based team are essential, with meaningful daily overlap with US business hours.



WORKING STYLE & EXPECTATIONS

●Operates with a high degree of independence, managing your own priorities within the direction set by the Director.

●Takes ownership of problems and fixes them before users notice.

●Treats monitoring, testing and documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought.

●Uses AI-assisted development tools to work faster without sacrificing quality.

●Explains technical issues and tradeoffs in plain language for non-technical stakeholders.



TYPICAL DEVELOPMENT WORKFLOW

This role follows an established workflow designed to keep the data platform reliable as it grows:

●Work is captured and prioritized as issues in Linear.

●All code lives in Git: branches, pull requests and code review before anything reaches production.

●New tables follow the team's medallion layering and naming standards.

●Every production pipeline ships with monitoring, quality checks and a runbook.

●Completed work closes the loop in Linear so stakeholders know what changed.



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ingestion & Integration

●Build and maintain ingestion from internal systems (CRM, TMS and product databases) and external vendor and public data feeds.

●Replace fragile or manual data pulls with scheduled, monitored jobs.

Pipelines & Modeling

●Build transformations from raw data into clean, documented tables.

●Follow the team's medallion layering, naming and code review standards.

●Tune slow queries and inefficient data stores.

Reliability & Monitoring

●Monitor pipelines and resolve failures before they reach users.

●Add data quality checks and flags, so users know which tables they can trust.

●Keep runbooks current, so any team member can operate a pipeline.

●Track compute cost and right-size jobs and clusters.

Support

●Deliver clean, documented data to analysts and business teams for reporting and analysis.

●Pick up backlog items as the Director prioritizes them.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

●Strong SQL and Python, including PySpark or Spark SQL.

●Production experience building and operating batch pipelines on a lakehouse or cloud warehouse.

●Data modeling for analytics: dimensional or medallion-style layers.

●Git-based workflow: branches, pull requests, code review.

●Habit of monitoring, testing and documenting what you build.

●Clear written English and comfort working async with a US team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

●Databricks experience: Unity Catalog, Jobs, Delta Lake, Lakeflow or DLT.

●Ingesting from Salesforce, MongoDB, Postgres or REST APIs.

●AWS basics (S3, IAM, Lambda).

●Experience with AI-assisted or agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar).

●Experience in logistics, freight or another operations-heavy industry.



SUCCESS MEASURES

●Pipeline reliability: scheduled jobs succeed on time, and failures are caught and fixed before users report them.

●Data quality: key tables pass automated checks, and other tables carry accurate quality flags.

●Throughput: backlog items delivered at a steady pace with little rework.

●Operability: every pipeline has a runbook and can be run by someone else.

●Cost: compute spend tracked and trending down per job as jobs are tuned.

title: Technical Operations Specialist – Payments, Proxies & Technical Infrastructure
description:
We are a growing international e-commerce business managing multiple online stores and client projects.



We are looking for a highly technical, resourceful and proactive person to join our operations team.



This is not a traditional Virtual Assistant position.



We need someone who is genuinely comfortable with technology, knows how to troubleshoot problems, understands different online platforms and can manage technical operations independently.



We are looking for a real problem-solver who is fast, reliable, hardworking and willing to take responsibility.



## Main Responsibilities

### 3. Technical Troubleshooting

- Investigate and resolve technical issues independently.

- Find solutions quickly when something is not working.

- Research unfamiliar tools and technologies.

- Identify problems before they become bigger operational issues.

### 4. General Technical Operations

- Set up and test new software and platforms.

- Help automate repetitive operational tasks.

- Manage different tools and technical environments.

- Take ownership of assigned tasks and complete them efficiently.

- Experience with PayPal and Payoneer.

- Experience with AdsPower, Multilogin, GoLogin or similar browser management tools.

- Good understanding of residential and ISP proxies.

- Knowledge of IP addresses, networking and browser configurations.

- Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

- Comfortable working with multiple platforms simultaneously.

- Fast learner who can adapt to new technologies.



**Additional advantages:**

- Basic Python or scripting knowledge.

- Experience with APIs and automation.

- Shopify and e-commerce experience.

- Experience with payment processing systems.

- Knowledge of networking and cybersecurity fundamentals.



## The Type of Person We Are Looking For



This is extremely important.



We want someone who is:

- A genuine hard worker.

- Highly proactive and independent.

- Technically curious and resourceful.

- Fast at executing tasks.

- Able to think independently and find solutions.

- Reliable and committed.

- Comfortable working under pressure.

- Available and focused throughout working hours.



We don't want someone who needs instructions for every single task.



When you encounter a problem, we expect you to investigate, research possible solutions and come back with a recommendation.



We value people who take ownership and genuinely want to improve.



## Compensation & Working Conditions



**Starting salary: $800/month.**

- One regular day off per week.

- Performance-based bonuses.

For someone who demonstrates exceptional technical skills, reliability and autonomy, we are willing to offer better compensation over time.



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term working relationship, not someone looking for a temporary job.



## Application Questions



Please answer all the following questions:

title: Sales Representative, US Website Company: $800 Base Plus Uncapped Commission
description:
Mirin is a small website company in East Lyme, Connecticut. We build a better homepage for local businesses, therapists first, from their own words and photos, before we ever contact them. Then we show it to the owner. They can put it online free, or on their own domain for $99 a month.



You will be the person who turns those homepages into customers.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Call business owners who opened the homepage we made for them, and the ones we can only reach by phone.

• Read and approve the first
 our system drafts for each business before it goes out under your name.

• Answer owners who write back, and help them keep their homepage.

• Work entirely inside our CRM. You call from your browser with a headset, and every call and
 is logged for you.



You never write a pitch from scratch, and you never call a random list. Every business you contact already has a homepage made for it.



WHAT YOU EARN

• $800 a month base, paid twice a month by Payoneer or Wise.

• Commission on every sale, more per sale as your month goes, with no cap:

   1st to 10th sale in a month: $50 for each Pro customer, $100 for each Business customer

   11th to 20th: $99 and $199

   21st to 30th: $149 and $299

   31st and on: $198 and $398

• 10 Pro sales in a month pay $500 in commission on top of your base. 20 pay $1,490. 30 pay $2,980. 40 pay $4,960.

• A sale counts when the customer pays their second monthly invoice, so your first month is base pay.

• We start with a paid two week trial.



HOURS

Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern time. That is a night shift in the Philippines (10 PM to 6 AM until March).



WHAT YOU NEED

• Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, neutral accent, and confidence on the phone with US small business owners.

• At least one year of outbound phone sales, appointment setting or closing for US clients.

• A reliable computer with Chrome, a stable internet connection with a backup, and a quiet room.

• A headset with a microphone. This is required for every call.

• A Google account to sign in with.

• You are comfortable with your own side of calls being recorded and transcribed for coaching. This is in the contract.



NICE TO HAVE

• You have sold websites, marketing services or software to small businesses.

• You have worked with therapists, clinics or other healthcare practices.

• You have used a CRM every day.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application subject with "Mirin East Lyme" so we know you read this post. Then include:



1. A voice recording of 60 to 90 seconds (a Vocaroo or Google Drive link). First, read this as if you were on a real call:



"Hi Dr. Benning, it's [your name] with Mirin, a small website company in East Lyme, Connecticut. I sent you a homepage we made for Mystic River Psychology on Tuesday. Did you have a chance to look?"



Then, in your own words, answer the owner who asks: "How much is it?" The facts: the homepage costs nothing to look at. It can go online free at a Mirin address, or on their own domain for $99 a month.



2. In three sentences, your best month in sales: what you sold, how many, and how you were paid.



3. When you could start.



Applications without the recording are not reviewed.

title: Marketplace Expert
description:
Marketplace Onboarding Specialist: Amazon, Walmart, Wayfair, Shopify + Target, Macy's, Kohl's

• Job type: Full-time (40 hrs/week). We'll consider part-time for strong candidates

• Wage: TBD. Paid test task before hiring

• Hours: At least 8 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time (9 AM–5 PM ET), Monday–Friday

• Start: Immediately

About Silk Home Living

Silk Home Living is a US home textiles manufacturer that sells to major retailers. Our main product is window curtains, under our house brands: Sun+Blk, Bon Luxe, Studio 9, Studio 9 Luxe, Aimee Maison, Cobble & Hill, Silk Home and others. We're growing our ecommerce business fast and need an experienced marketplace specialist who can get our catalog live across several channels in weeks, not months.

The first project is ready: 58 curtain SKUs (about 44,000 units) with titles, descriptions, UPCs, carton dimensions and product photos already prepared. We need someone to take that data and get it live, shipped in and selling.

What You'll Do

Amazon (Seller Central + FBA)

• Upload listings using category flat files (curtains), including parent/child variations

• Manage Brand Registry: follow up on pending cases, reapply for rejected brands, and register new brands

• Upload images, build A+ Content and fix suppressed or stranded listings

• Create FBA inbound shipments (Send to Amazon) with case-pack data and box labels

Walmart (Seller Center + WFS)

• Set up items with Walmart's bulk item spreadsheets

• Complete Walmart Brand Portal enrollment for our brands

• Convert items to WFS and create inbound orders

Wayfair (Partner Home + CastleGate)

• Load products using Wayfair's class-specific product spreadsheets

• Set up CastleGate forecasts and inbound shipments

Shopify

• Import products by CSV, organize collections, and connect fulfillment through Amazon MCF

New marketplace applications: Target Plus, Macy's, Kohl's

• Prepare and submit marketplace applications with assortment spreadsheets and required documents

• Handle onboarding once approved: Mirakl catalog setup (Macy's), Target Plus partner portal setup, and Kohl's onboarding

Across all channels

• Keep listing data consistent everywhere (titles, attributes, pricing, inventory)

• Track every SKU's status per channel in our master spreadsheet

• Send a short daily update: what went live, what's blocked, and what you need from us

Requirements

• 3+ years of hands-on work in Amazon Seller Central and Walmart Seller Center, uploading listings in bulk (flat files and item spreadsheets), not just editing one listing at a time

• Proven experience with FBA inbound shipments and Brand Registry (including appeals and reapplications)

• Experience with WFS and/or Wayfair CastleGate

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, cleaning and mapping data between templates)

• Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication

• Reliable internet, a backup power source, and your own computer

Nice to Have

• Experience in home goods, textiles or curtains (size and color variations, room-darkening/blackout attributes)

• Onboarding experience with Target Plus, Macy's (Mirakl), or Kohl's Marketplace

• Experience with multichannel tools such as ChannelEngine, Zentail, Rithum/ChannelAdvisor, or Celigo

• Basic image editing (white backgrounds, resizing to marketplace specs)

• Experience with Amazon or Walmart advertising (Sponsored Products)

Your First 30 Days

• Week 1: Review our prepared listing files and image library; flag missing data; get access to all seller accounts

• Week 2: Get all 58 SKUs live on Amazon and Walmart; submit the remaining Brand Registry / Brand Portal applications

• Week 3: Create FBA and WFS inbound shipments; get products live on Wayfair and Shopify

• Week 4: Submit Target Plus, Macy's and Kohl's applications; send a written status report on every channel

How We Work

• You'll get your own user login with permissions on each platform. We never share owner passwords, and you should never ask for them

• Communication through
 and Microsoft Teams

• Long-term role: after onboarding, you'll manage day-to-day listings, inventory and catalog growth across all channels

How to Apply

Send us:

1. Your resume and expected monthly rate

2. A short list of marketplaces you've personally onboarded or managed, with roughly how many SKUs on each

3. One example of a bulk upload you completed (Amazon flat file or Walmart item spreadsheet) and a problem you solved during it

4. Your answer to this: "A new Amazon listing for a 2-pack of 52x84 curtains is suppressed for a missing attribute. What do you check first, and how do you fix it in bulk for 40 similar SKUs?"

Start your application with the words "FBA READY" so we know you read this post. Applications without it won't be reviewed.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid 2-hour test task: mapping 5 of our SKUs into an Amazon flat file and a Walmart item spreadsheet.

Summary

ABOUT US

ATOM Modular designs and builds modular buildings in factories in Australia (Victoria and Queensland). The buildings are then trucked to sites for clients in mining, industry and other sectors. Our Preconstruction team gets each project ready before the factory starts building it.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You will design modular buildings and make the drawings that bring them to life: manufacturing drawings that show our factory exactly how to build each module, site layouts that show where buildings go on the client's land, and fit-out layouts that show what goes inside. You will work remotely from the Philippines and report to the Preconstruction Manager. We expect you to work on your own with little supervision and to help guide junior drafters.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Design modular buildings and their layouts, including living suites, kitchens, dining areas, offices and other shared spaces.

• Make manufacturing drawings in Revit: detailed plans, frames, parts and assembly drawings the factory uses to cut, weld and put each module together.

• Make site layouts that show where each building sits on site, plus access paths, crane and truck positions, and links to services like power and water.

• Plan and draw fit-out and FF&E layouts (furniture, fixtures and equipment), showing where beds, desks, tables, appliances and other items go inside each building.

• Turn client and engineer comments into updated drawings and keep each revision tidy and tracked.

• Work with our estimator and purchasing team so drawings match the materials list and orders.

• Check your own work and review junior drafters' drawings before they go out.

• Spot design problems early and suggest fixes before they reach the factory or site.

• Update tasks and notes in our project system (Odoo) so the team always knows where each job is up to.

 

WHAT YOU NEED

 

Qualifications and experience

• A diploma or degree in drafting, architecture, civil or mechanical engineering, or similar.

• 2–5 years of drafting experience, including manufacturing or shop drawings.

• Experience with steel framing, modular or prefabricated buildings.

• Experience making site plans or layouts.

 

Technical skills

• Strong Revit skills. AutoCAD is also needed for site layouts.

• Able to read and understand drawings from other trades, including architectural, mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and fire protection plans.

• Good understanding of plumbing and hydraulics (water supply and drainage).

• Good understanding of fire safety and fire protection requirements (for example, fire exits, fire-rated walls, smoke alarms and sprinklers).

• Comfortable using AI tools to help check drawings and catch mistakes.

• Good working knowledge of Microsoft Teams and other Microsoft 365 tools (Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint) for team chats, meetings and sharing files.

 

Work style

• Good attention to detail and the ability to manage several projects at once.

• Good time management, so drawings are finished on schedule.

• Able to stay calm and keep quality high under tight deadlines and pressure.

• Willing to work paid overtime when needed to finish a project.

• Strong team player who works well with others, shares information openly and helps teammates get the job done.

• Eager to learn and open to feedback (teachable).

• Willing to research things on your own when you hit something new.

• Clear written English for
s and drawing notes.

 

Setup

• A reliable computer and internet connection.

• Able to work during Australian business hours (AEST).

 

NICE TO HAVE

• Knowledge of Australian building rules, such as the NCC (National Construction Code) and Australian Standards.

• Experience on mining or industrial projects.

• Basic understanding of transport and crane lifting limits for large modules.

• Able to design mechanical (heating, cooling and air flow), electrical (power and lighting) and hydraulic (water and drainage) systems.

 

HOW TO APPLY

Please send your CV and portfolio to 
 portfolio should include at least one manufacturing drawing, one site layout, and one fit-out or building design.



Please use "Drafter – [Full Name]" as the subject line of your application

Executive

Growth

Operations

Fulfillment

The OBM helps ensure that leadership decisions actually get implemented clearly, calmly, and on time.

Supporting launches, promotions, and live webinars maximizing efficiency and conversions

Coordinating timelines across internal team members and external agencies

Ensuring launch assets move through clear create → review → test phases

Monitoring dependencies and flagging risks before they become fires



The OBM helps create calm, repeatable, and effective launch executions.



3. OPERATIONS

The OBM is a systems thinker who thrives on structure, clarity, and clean workflows.

Responsibilities include:

Creating and maintaining project boards and processes

Setting up and organizing project management software, Google Drive, and internal documentation such as SOPs

Managing onboarding workflows for members, clients, and contractors

Tracking KPIs and operational metrics



The OBM builds systems that allow the business to grow without burning people out.



4. FULFILLMENT

The OBM acts as the final quality check before anything goes live.

Responsibilities include:

End-to-end testing of launches, funnels, and workflows

Verifying registration,
, tagging, checkout, and replay flows

If something is live, it should work and reflect the high standards of the Fancy Scientist brand.



THE DAY-TO-DAY

This role may include, but is not limited to:

Creating and managing project boards

Translating launch plans into clear execution timelines (we have detailed processes to reference - so part of the OBM role will ensure they’re optimized and followed)

Coordinating tasks across VAs and contractors

QA testing funnels, webinars,
s, and checkouts

Improve overall workflows to reduce CEO involvement



CORE OUTCOMES THE OBM IS RESPONSIBLE FOR

Clear, execution-ready launch plans

Calm, confident execution

Team alignment, management, and communication

Founder energy protected

Creating repeatable systems for future launches and programs



THIS POSITION IS FOR SOMEONE WHO

Is resourceful, self-sufficient, and proactive

Takes full ownership and pride in their work

Is obsessed with organization, checklists, and clean systems

Communicates clearly and confidently (and isn’t afraid to speak up)

Spots problems and proposes solutions

Thrives in fast-moving environments with multiple priorities

Is technologically savvy and systems-oriented

Can receive direct feedback without defensiveness

Values quality, integrity, and follow-through

- 4+ years in client success, operations or account management, including experience leading a team

Nice to have

- Mandarin, which is a big plus

- Experience working with Chinese suppliers or factories

- Experience with sales handovers or onboarding processes

What we offer

- Salary: USD 2,000 – 2,500 per month (fixed), plus a performance bonus (negotiable)

- A senior leadership role with a growth path toward COO

- Full-time, long-term, 100% remote (Philippines preferred, other locations considered)

description:

With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US.
