With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:



The Acquisition Training & Performance Coach is responsible for providing dedicated training, coaching, and performance support to the Acquisition Department. This role focuses on developing role-specific knowledge, skills, processes, and behaviors required for successful performance across Acquisition functions. The role is responsible for delivering Acquisition-specific training, facilitating onboarding and refresher sessions, identifying capability gaps, and providing ongoing coaching to improve contractor performance, quality, productivity, and adherence to established processes and standards.



What You’ll Do:



Training Program Design & Development:

• Design and develop engaging training programs, modules, and materials aligned with Acquisition operational goals and requirements.

• Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.

• Customize learning solutions based on Acquisition business needs, role requirements, and competency gaps.

• Develop practical learning activities, assessments, and knowledge checks to reinforce understanding and application.

• Update training materials and resources when Acquisition processes, systems, tools, or SOPs change.

• Identify recurring knowledge gaps and develop appropriate training interventions.



Training Delivery & Facilitation:

• Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for contractors within the Acquisition Department.

• Coach and support facilitators/trainers as needed.

• Conduct onboarding, process training, refresher training, and upskilling sessions specific to Acquisition functions.

• Provide additional training or remediation to contractors who require further support.

• Support newly trained contractors during their transition into production.



Performance Coaching:

• Provide individual and group coaching to Acquisition contractors to support continuous performance improvement.

• Review performance results, quality findings, productivity data, and other relevant metrics to identify coaching opportunities.

• Provide timely, constructive, and actionable feedback to contractors.

• Develop coaching or performance improvement plans for contractors who require additional support.

• Monitor progress following coaching interventions and provide follow-up coaching as needed.

• Reinforce correct processes, behaviors, and best practices through continuous coaching.

• Recognize strong performance and encourage continuous development among high-performing contractors.

• Partner with Acquisition Team Leads to support performance improvement while maintaining clear accountability within the operational leadership structure.



Training Needs Analysis & Capability Assessment:

• Conduct training needs assessments within the Acquisition Department.

• Collaborate with Acquisition Team Leads to identify recurring performance issues that may be addressed through training or coaching.

• Analyze performance trends to determine whether gaps are related to knowledge, skills, process understanding, or execution.

• Recommend appropriate training and coaching interventions based on identified needs.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen role readiness, competency, and overall team capability.



Program Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:

• Measure training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.

• Continuously improve programs based on evaluation results.

• Evaluate whether training and coaching interventions result in improvements in quality, productivity, accuracy, and process adherence.

• Identify recurring performance trends and recommend improvements to training content, coaching strategies, or operational processes.

• Work with Acquisition leadership to address recurring knowledge, skill, and performance gaps.

• Recommend improvements to onboarding, training, coaching, and knowledge reinforcement processes.



Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Partner with the Acquisition Operations Team Lead and Acquisition Team Leads to align learning initiatives with Acquisition operational priorities and performance goals.

• Provide recommendations to Acquisition leadership regarding capability gaps and performance development opportunities.

• Collaborate with Acquisition stakeholders to support process changes, new initiatives, and operational improvements requiring training or coaching.

• Support Acquisition initiatives that require training, coaching, or capability development.



Learning Administration & Reporting:

• Track training attendance, completion, and effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate training records and generate reports.

• Track coaching activities, performance improvement interventions, and competency outcomes.

• Prepare reports on training participation, competency results, coaching activities, and performance trends.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Acquisition training materials and documentation.

• Provide management with insights and recommendations based on training and coaching data.



What We’re Looking For:



Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Education, or related field.



Experience:

• At least 3–4 years of experience in Learning and Development, Training, Coaching, Operations Training, or a related field.

• Approximately 3–4 years of relevant Sales experience, preferably with BPO or outbound Sales experience. Relevant Sales experience and demonstrated capability are highly preferred given the operational requirements of the role.



Technical Skills:

• Strong knowledge of instructional design models

• Experience in creating learning modules, facilitator guides, and e-learning content

• Proficiency in Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms

• Skilled in Microsoft Office tools, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

• Strong understanding of Sales processes and customer engagement, with the ability to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement.

• Ability to audit and review customer calls and assess areas such as confidence, engagement, probing, active listening, and adherence to established processes and standards.



Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Strong facilitation and audience engagement capability

• Stakeholder management and business partnering skills

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking ability

• Effective time management and project coordination skills

• Adaptability in handling diverse learners and changing priorities

• Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback through performance coaching.



Industry Knowledge:

• Foundational knowledge of upstream oil and gas operations, production, and well lifecycle.

• Understanding of marketed deal structures and acquisition processes is a plus.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first work environment.

• Demonstrates discipline, focus, and reliability in support tasks.

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.



What's in it for You:

Other Requirements

Qualifications

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Senior Shopify Store Manager – Experienced Candidates Only
description:
# Hiring: E-commerce Operations & Process Manager (Fashion Dropshipping)



**Position:** E-commerce Operations & Process Manager  

**Industry:** Fashion Dropshipping (Multiple Shopify Stores)  

**Work Type:** Remote  

**Experience Level:** Experienced Professionals Only



### About Us



We operate multiple fashion dropshipping stores targeting different markets, and we're looking for an **experienced E-commerce Operations & Process Manager** to organize, coordinate, and optimize our daily operations.



We already have a team responsible for product listing, advertising, creative production, and customer support.



**We need someone who can take ownership of the operational workflow, connect all departments, and ensure everything runs smoothly without constant supervision.**



### Key Responsibilities



**1. Process Management & Team Coordination**

- Understand our entire workflow, from product selection to order fulfillment.

- Coordinate between product researchers, suppliers, product listers, advertising teams, and customer support.

- Assign and track tasks, follow up on deadlines, and ensure responsibilities are clear.

- Identify bottlenecks, improve processes, and prevent operational delays.

- Build and maintain clear SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).



**2. Supplier Communication & Product Cost Management**

- Once we provide product images, contact our designated suppliers to request product sourcing information.

- Confirm COGS (Cost of Goods Sold), shipping costs, product availability, and fulfillment details.

- Organize all collected information in a structured Google Sheet.

- Maintain accurate and updated product cost records across multiple stores.

- Follow up with suppliers whenever pricing or availability needs clarification.



**3. Product Pricing & Break-Even Calculations**

- Calculate recommended retail prices based on the target Break-Even ROAS we provide.

- Calculate Break-Even CPA for each product.

- Factor in product costs, shipping, and any relevant transaction fees.

- Maintain organized pricing sheets showing COGS, retail price, Break-Even ROAS, and Break-Even CPA.

- Ensure pricing information is communicated correctly to the product listing and advertising teams before launching products.



**4. Customer Support Coordination**

- Communicate regularly with our customer support team.

- Coordinate with suppliers to resolve shipping delays, fulfillment problems, and product-related issues.

- Make sure the customer support team has accurate product, shipping, and stock information.

- Monitor recurring customer issues and help implement solutions to prevent them.



**5. Reporting & Operational Improvement**

- Maintain a centralized system to track products, tasks, launch readiness, supplier updates, and outstanding issues.

- Provide daily updates on completed tasks, pending actions, and blockers.

- Proactively identify operational problems before they affect sales or customer experience.

- Recommend improvements and automation opportunities to reduce manual work and increase efficiency.



### Requirements



- **Proven experience managing operations or processes in an e-commerce or dropshipping business.**

- Experience working with multiple Shopify stores is highly preferred.

- Strong understanding of product sourcing, supplier communication, and fulfillment operations.

- Comfortable with COGS, pricing calculations, Break-Even ROAS, and CPA.

- Advanced organizational skills using Google Sheets and project management tools.

- Strong communication and team coordination skills.

- Ability to manage multiple workflows simultaneously.

- Proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of working independently.

- Good written and spoken English.



### Important: Experienced Candidates Only



We are **not looking for a beginner, a general virtual assistant, or someone who needs to learn e-commerce operations from scratch.**



We need someone who has already managed similar workflows and understands how to organize an established team.



You should be able to **improve our existing processes, not just follow instructions.**



### How to Apply



Please include the following information in your application:



1. Describe your previous experience managing e-commerce or dropshipping operations.

2. How many Shopify stores or team members have you coordinated simultaneously?

3. Which tools have you used for process management and task tracking?

4. Have you worked with product costing, Break-Even ROAS, and Break-Even CPA calculations?

5. Explain how you would organize the workflow from receiving a product image to having the product ready for launch.

6. Share an example of an operational process you improved in a previous role.

7. State your availability and expected monthly salary.



**Please provide specific examples from your previous experience. Generic or AI-generated applications without relevant experience will not be considered.**



### Our Goal



We're looking for a long-term operations partner who can bring structure, accountability, and efficiency to our multi-store business.



**The ideal candidate doesn't wait to be told what to do next. They know how to keep the entire operation moving.**

title: STR | Senior Operations & Guest Experience Coordinator
description:
Luxury Short-Term Rental Company | London, UK

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Working Hours: UK Business Hours 9AM - 5PM (GMT/BST)

Portfolio: 60+ Luxury Short-Term Rental Properties

Industry: Luxury Hospitality / Short-Term Rentals / Property Management

Reports To: Founder / Company Director



About Us

We are a London-based luxury short-term rental company managing a growing portfolio of over 60 premium properties. Our business is built around delivering exceptional guest experiences, maintaining immaculate property standards and ensuring our operations run efficiently and professionally. We operate in a demanding, fast-paced hospitality environment where attention to detail, responsiveness, reliability and exceptional customer service are essential. We are now looking for an outstanding Senior Operations & Guest Experience Coordinator to take ownership of our day-to-day operations.



This is a senior, hands-on operational position requiring someone who is exceptionally organised, highly disciplined, proactive and capable of managing multiple moving parts independently. You will act as the central point of coordination between our guests, housekeeping teams, maintenance contractors and management.



Our objective is to hire someone who can take responsibility for the daily running of our portfolio, resolve routine operational issues independently and ensure everything operates to the highest possible standard without constant management supervision. We are looking for an exceptional individual who takes genuine pride in their work and consistently strives for excellence. This is not an entry-level position.



Key Responsibilities

1. Guest Communication & Luxury Guest Experience

You will take primary responsibility for guest communications across our entire portfolio.

You will be expected to deliver consistently exceptional customer service and ensure every guest receives a seamless, professional and welcoming experience.



Responsibilities include:

- Independently managing guest communications across OTA’s, WhatsApp,
 and other relevant channels.

- Responding to guest enquiries promptly, accurately and professionally.

- Managing pre-arrival communication, check-in instructions, property access information and check-out procedures.

- Assisting guests with questions, requests and issues throughout their stay.

- Handling guest complaints professionally, calmly and with a solutions-focused approach.

- Coordinating guest requests with housekeeping, maintenance and other service providers.

- Proactively following up to ensure guest issues have been fully resolved.

- Identifying potential guest experience problems before they escalate.

- Supporting excellent guest reviews and maintaining our reputation for five-star hospitality.

- Maintaining a consistently friendly, positive, polished and professional communication style.



Every guest interaction must reflect the standards of a premium London hospitality company. We expect outstanding written and spoken English, exceptional customer service skills and the ability to communicate confidently with demanding or high-expectation guests.



2. Maintenance & Contractor Coordination

-You will manage the day-to-day coordination of maintenance issues and contractors across the portfolio.

Responsibilities include:



- Receiving and assessing maintenance reports from guests, cleaners and other team members.

- Prioritising maintenance issues according to urgency and guest impact.

- Coordinating contractors and arranging suitable access.

- Following up on repairs until completion is confirmed.

- Keeping guests updated when maintenance work affects their stay.

- Maintaining accurate records of reported defects, scheduled works and outstanding issues.

- Identifying recurring maintenance problems and recommending preventative solutions.

- Ensuring urgent issues are escalated promptly according to company procedures.

- Coordinating with management when expenditure or decisions exceed your authority.



We expect you to take ownership of operational issues from the moment they are reported until they are satisfactorily resolved. Simply forwarding a message or assigning a task is not considered completion.



3. Independent Daily Operations Management

This is the core responsibility of the role.

You will be expected to independently oversee the day-to-day coordination of our portfolio, ensuring that guests, cleaners, contractors and other team members are working together efficiently.



Responsibilities include:

- Managing the daily operational schedule across 60+ properties.

- Overseeing arrivals, departures, cleaning progress and property readiness.

- Coordinating communication between all operational teams.

- Monitoring outstanding tasks and ensuring they are completed on time.

- Identifying potential issues before they impact guests.

- Resolving routine operational problems independently within agreed authority limits.

- Prioritising competing tasks and urgent situations effectively.

- Maintaining clear oversight of the operational status of each property.

- Ensuring no requests, tasks or issues are forgotten or left unresolved.

- Escalating significant problems with clear explanations and recommended solutions.

- Keeping management informed without requiring constant direction or supervision.



We want someone who is consistently one step ahead. You should be able to identify what needs to happen, organise the relevant people, communicate effectively and ensure the required outcome is achieved.



4. Booking Administration & Operational Accuracy

You will help ensure all reservation information, operational records and property details remain accurate and organised.

Responsibilities include:



- Monitoring upcoming bookings, amendments, cancellations and special requests.

- Maintaining accurate arrival and departure information.

- Chasing Upsells

- Checking guest requirements and communicating them to the relevant teams.

- Identifying booking conflicts, access issues or operational risks.

- Maintaining organised property records and task management systems.

- Updating guest communication templates and operational checklists.

- Ensuring booking information is consistent across relevant systems.

- Maintaining accurate records of completed and outstanding tasks.



Accuracy is essential. Incorrect access instructions, overlooked bookings or missed cleaning schedules can directly affect our guests and our reputation.



5. Daily Reporting & Management Communication

Although you will be expected to operate independently, clear communication with management is essential.

You will be responsible for providing concise, accurate operational updates, including:



- Upcoming arrivals and departures.

- Cleaning schedules and property-readiness confirmations.

- Outstanding maintenance issues.

- Guest complaints or significant requests.

- Operational risks or anticipated delays.

- Tasks requiring management approval.

- Any recurring issues or opportunities for improvement.



Our expectation is that management can quickly understand the operational position of the business without needing to chase individual updates.



6. Operational Improvement & Problem Prevention

We are looking for someone who does more than maintain existing processes. You should actively look for ways to improve the efficiency, reliability and quality of our operations.



Responsibilities include:

- Identifying recurring operational problems.

- Suggesting improvements to guest communication and internal coordination.

- Improving checklists, templates and standard operating procedures.

- Helping streamline housekeeping and maintenance workflows.

- Identifying opportunities to reduce avoidable mistakes.

- Supporting the development of scalable processes as the property portfolio grows.



Who We Are Looking For?

We are looking for an exceptionally capable professional with a strong operational mindset. You should be someone who thrives on responsibility, enjoys solving problems and takes genuine satisfaction in making complex operations run smoothly.



Essential Qualities

- Exceptional Organisation - You must be able to manage a large volume of bookings, guest conversations, maintenance issues and operational tasks simultaneously.

- Outstanding Attention to Detail - You must have an extremely high level of accuracy and consistency. We expect you to check important information, follow established procedures and minimise avoidable errors.

- Exceptional Communication - You must speak and write English to an outstanding professional standard. You should be articulate, friendly, confident and able to adapt your communication to different guests and situations.

- Warm, Positive & Professional Personality - You must be naturally friendly, approachable, enthusiastic and genuinely passionate about delivering excellent customer service.

- Extreme Reliability & Discipline - You must be punctual, consistent, dependable and capable of maintaining excellent performance without constant supervision.

- Strong Ownership & Accountability - You must take responsibility for tasks and outcomes. When something goes wrong, we expect you to act quickly, communicate clearly and work towards a solution.

- Proactive Thinking - You must anticipate problems rather than waiting for them to happen.

- Excellent Prioritisation - You must be capable of distinguishing between urgent guest issues, time-sensitive operational tasks and lower-priority administrative work.

- Calmness Under Pressure - You must remain organised, professional and solutions-focused when dealing with simultaneous guest requests, maintenance emergencies or last-minute changes.

- Commitment to Excellence - You must genuinely care about the quality of your work and take pride in delivering exceptional results.



Required Skills & Experience



Essential Requirements

- Significant previous experience in short-term rental operations, hospitality operations, property management or a closely related operational coordination role.

- Proven experience managing multiple properties, operational workflows or service teams.

- Demonstrated ability to independently manage day-to-day operations.

- Outstanding written and spoken English.

- Excellent guest communication and customer service skills.

- Experience coordinating housekeeping teams, maintenance contractors or external service providers.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and resolve problems independently.

- Experience using booking platforms, spreadsheets, task management systems and digital communication tools.

- Confidence working in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.

- Ability to work full-time during UK business hours.

- Reliable internet connection, suitable equipment and a professional remote working environment.

- Experience with Hostaway.



Highly Desirable

- Direct experience managing operations for a portfolio of 30+ short-term rental properties.

- Previous experience within luxury hospitality or premium serviced accommodation.

- Strong working knowledge of OTA’s.

- Familiarity with London short-term rental operations and guest expectations.

- Experience handling complex guest complaints and operational emergencies.

- Experience improving operational systems and standard operating procedures.



Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured by:



- Guest Experience

- Fast, professional and accurate guest communication.

- Consistently positive guest feedback.

- Effective resolution of guest requests and complaints.

- Property Readiness

- Properties confirmed ready before guest arrivals.

- Reliable housekeeping coordination.

- Minimal preventable delays or cleaning-related complaints.

- Operational Efficiency

- Maintenance and operational tasks followed through to completion.

- Accurate booking and property information.

- Effective coordination between guests, cleaners and contractors.

- Proactive identification and prevention of operational problems.

- Independence & Accountability

- Routine operations managed without constant management involvement.

- Tasks completed without repeated reminders.

- Clear, accurate reporting.

- Appropriate escalation of serious issues and decisions outside approved authority.

- Quality & Consistency

- Strong attention to detail.

- Reliable adherence to company procedures.

- Continuous improvement in operational performance.

- Specific performance targets will be agreed during onboarding.



Working Arrangements

Position: Full-Time

Location: Fully Remote

Time Zone: UK (GMT/BST)

Working Hours: Standard UK business hours, with exact hours to be confirmed.

Portfolio: 60+ luxury short-term rental properties in London.

Reporting: Directly to the Founder / Company Director.

Compensation: Competitive, dependent on experience and suitability.



The successful candidate will be responsible for managing operations during their agreed working hours. Urgent matters outside those hours will be handled through the company's designated out-of-hours arrangements.



Our Standards

We operate in luxury hospitality, where details matter and expectations are exceptionally high. We expect our team members to demonstrate professionalism, discipline, accountability, accuracy and a genuine commitment to delivering excellent results. This is a position of significant responsibility. We are not looking for someone who needs to be constantly reminded, chased or supervised. We want someone who takes ownership, thinks independently, communicates proactively and consistently delivers exceptional work. We are looking for the best of the best. 



How to Apply

Please submit:

- Your CV and a brief professional introduction.

- Details of your previous experience in short-term rental, hospitality or property operations.

- The number of properties you have previously helped manage.

- The booking platforms, property management systems and operational tools you have used.

- An example of a challenging operational situation you successfully resolved.

- An explanation of why you believe you are an exceptional candidate for this position.

- Your salary expectations and availability to start.





Practical Assessment

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a practical operational assessment. Please submit a video explaining how you will handle this scenario, if no video is submitted your application will not be considered.



Scenario:



It is 2:00 PM on a busy Friday.

You are coordinating operations across 60 London properties.

Six guests are due to check in within the next two hours.

A cleaner reports that one property will not be ready on time.

A guest at another property reports that the heating is not working.

A maintenance contractor has not confirmed attendance at a third property.

Two new guest enquiries require responses.

The company director is unavailable for the next hour.



Explain how you would prioritise, coordinate and resolve these situations. Include examples of the messages you would send and how you would keep track of every outstanding task.

title: Microsoft 365 Security & Access Engineer
description:
Work setup: 100% remote, independent contractor

Schedule: Approximately 25 hours/week initially; some overlap with client business hours then 8 hrs/week ongoing support



The Opportunity



We are looking for a hands-on Microsoft 365 security and access engineer who can design and help implement a practical, secure information-sharing workflow. You will d
 who can access which information, who can approve access, how different organizations remain separated, and how access and actions are recorded. You will work with an existing technical team to launch a controlled pilot and hand it over with clear documentation.

We welcome applicants with backgrounds in Microsoft 365 engineering, Entra ID, identity and access management (IAM), cloud security, infrastructure engineering, or solutions architecture. Your demonstrated work matters more than your job title or certifications.



What You Will Deliver in the First Four Weeks:



Review the current users, information flows, permissions, and main security risks; agree on a realistic pilot scope with the team.

Design an access model for two or more organizations, including roles, approval rules, least-privilege permissions, and protected information boundaries.

Configure or guide Microsoft 365 / Entra ID controls for an initial
-based workflow, including groups, shared mailboxes, MFA, and appropriate access policies.

Define access changes for onboarding, role changes, temporary access, and offboarding, including revocation and audit records.

Document permissions for service accounts or AI agents where relevant, including actions that require human approval.

Test unauthorized-access scenarios, verify logs and revocation, resolve critical pilot defects with the team, and provide a usable handover.



Our Five Must-Haves:



Clear spoken and written English: understand questions, explain trade-offs simply, and communicate directly with a nontechnical stakeholder.

Proven personal ownership: show one live security, identity, or access-control solution you personally designed or materially architected, and explain exactly what you did.

Sound technical judgment: explain why you chose specific roles, permissions, scopes, tenant boundaries, or environments instead of simply listing technologies.

Practical Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and access-security experience: hands-on work with identity, MFA, groups, permissions, least privilege, and protecting information across teams or clients.

Problem-solving and delivery: investigate access failures or suspected exposure, test controls, work with developers, and complete a usable pilot with documentation.



Helpful, But Not Required:



Microsoft or other security certifications; ISO 27001 or SOC 2 exposure.

Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, automation, APIs, AI agents, or service identities.

Prior consulting or MSP work supporting multiple organizations.





What Success Looks Like

The pilot works, unauthorized users cannot cross defined information boundaries, access can be granted and revoked appropriately, actions can be traced, and the internal team can operate the setup after handover. Scope and acceptance tests will be agreed at kickoff to fit the contracted hours.



How We Interview

Be prepared to describe one system you personally designed, why you made its security decisions, and what you would do if a user could access another client’s information. We value clear thinking, practical examples, and honest answers over jargon.



To Apply:



Send your CV and a short description of one Microsoft 365 / identity-access project you personally designed or implemented. Include your specific responsibilities, technologies used, availability, and confirmation that the proposed hourly rate works for you

title: Senior Graphic Designer – Packaging & Branding (Adobe Creative Cloud)

We are looking for our first senior graphic designer: a long-term, part-time team member who masters Adobe Creative Cloud and loves real, printed work.



ADOBE IS A MUST

Our core work is done in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign, and we deliver print-ready files to professional printers. Using Canva for quick social assets is fine, but this role is not for designers who can only work in Canva or with templates.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Packaging design: cans, bottles, pouches and boxes, including dielines and print-ready files

- Print: flyers, posters, menus, point-of-sale and event materials

- Digital ads and social media assets in multiple formats

- Brand identities: supporting full brandbooks (logo, colour and type systems, guidelines)

- Production: adapting master designs into variants, sizes and languages



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years of professional graphic design experience (agency/studio is a plus)

- Strong portfolio with packaging and brand identity work

- Advanced, hands-on mastery of Illustrator, Photoshop and InDesign: vector construction, clean layered files, artboards, styles, master pages, colour management and preflight

- Solid print knowledge: CMYK/Pantone, bleed, dielines, file preparation for printers

- Excellent eye for typography, layout and detail

- Good written and spoken English

- Own equipment, reliable internet, and 2–3 hours daily overlap with Central European Time (e.g. 3–6 PM PH time)



NICE TO HAVE

- Food & beverage or lifestyle brand experience

- Basic motion design (After Effects)

- 3D mock-ups or packaging renders

- Canva for quick social content



WHAT WE OFFER

- 15–20 hours per week to start, with room to grow

- 100% remote, flexible schedule

- Long-term collaboration with a growing European studio

- Work on recognisable brands and real printed products

- Direct feedback from an experienced creative lead



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the sentence: "I am fluent in Illustrator and InDesign." Applications without this sentence will not be read.



Include:

1. Your portfolio link (Behance, website or PDF) with at least 3 packaging or branding projects

2. A screenshot of one of those projects open in Illustrator or InDesign, with the layers panel and artboards visible

3. A short answer: how do you set up a packaging file for print (dieline, bleed, colour)?

4. A short introduction (max. 200 words) and the project you are most proud of

5. Your hourly rate and weekly availability



Process: portfolio review → paid test assignment (2–3 hours) → 30-minute video call → trial month → long-term collaboration.

title: Copywriter
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We're a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



You'll write the copy that sits at the center of our growth. It's work that goes live quickly and is measured by real results, so you'll know what worked within days.



For a gifted writer who's fascinated by persuasion and wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: ownership of the voice of a growing brand.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Write words that move people. Stories and copy that pull a skeptical reader in, build belief, and move them to act. You'll lead with the angle, the hook, and the proof that earn the click and the order.



Script video that holds attention. Write the scripts for the videos that carry our brand: the hook in the first seconds, the story that keeps people watching, and the line that closes it.



Own the brand voice. Make Cellexia Labs sound like itself everywhere a customer meets us: confident, clear, and credible.



Turn insight into messaging. Dig into customer reviews, support conversations, and ingredient science to find the language customers actually use, then build every piece around it.



Make complex things simple. Take formulation details and ingredient science and turn them into benefits a customer understands in seconds, while staying accurate and compliant.



Test relentlessly. Ship variations of angles, hooks, and openings, read the results with the marketing team, and double down on what wins. Your best work is the work the data backs.



What we look for



Command of the craft. You write sharply and clearly, and you can tell a line that lands from one that merely sounds good. You edit your own work hard.



A pull toward persuasion. You're fascinated by what makes people say yes: the customer's doubts, the offer, the proof, the words that earn trust. You don't need a background in sales or persuasion. You need real curiosity about how words move people, and the drive to learn from what the numbers tell you.



Ownership. You treat every piece of copy as yours until it performs. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Curiosity. You research before you write. You're willing to understand ingredients, customers, and competitors until the words come from real understanding.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [2+] years of professional writing, with a portfolio that shows it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or other consumer brands is a strong advantage. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. You'll never wait on a chain of sign-offs. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact you can see. Copy goes live fast here, and results come back quickly. You'll watch your words move the numbers.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the writer who shapes our voice is the writer best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That's why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you've worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you'll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we'll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don't talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply here:

title: Amazon Compliance Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Compliance Specialist to oversee product compliance across Amazon marketplaces. This role is responsible for ensuring products meet Amazon's regulatory and safety requirements, managing product testing and certifications, submitting compliance documentation, and resolving compliance-related issues to keep listings active and in good standing.



The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Amazon Seller Central, product compliance processes, and working with testing laboratories and manufacturers to obtain required approvals.



Key Responsibilities

Manage Amazon product compliance requirements for new and existing listings.

Coordinate product testing and obtain required certifications, including CPCs, GCCs, ASTM, CPSIA, CPSC, and other applicable documentation.

Submit compliance documents through Amazon Seller Central and respond to requests from Amazon's Product Compliance team.

Monitor listings for compliance warnings, suppressions, and documentation requests.

Resolve compliance-related listing issues quickly to minimize downtime

Prepare and submit appeals, Plans of Action (POAs), and supporting documentation when required.

Work with manufacturers, suppliers, and third-party testing laboratories to ensure products meet regulatory standards.

Maintain organized records of compliance documents, testing reports, and certification renewals.

Ensure documentation is accurate, complete, and readily available for audits or Amazon requests. 

Monitor Amazon policy updates and ensure ongoing compliance across product listings.

Work closely with Product Development to ensure new products meet compliance requirements before launch.

Partner with Marketplace, Operations, and Warehouse teams to support compliant product launches.



Required Qualifications

2+ years of experience in Amazon product compliance or a similar regulatory compliance role.

Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Amazon compliance processes.

Experience obtaining and managing product testing, certifications, and regulatory documentation.

Familiarity with U.S. consumer product safety regulations, especially children's products

Experience working with third-party testing laboratories and manufacturers.

Proven ability to resolve Amazon compliance cases and communicate effectively with Amazon support teams.

Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills.



Success in This Role

A successful Amazon Compliance Specialist will:

Maintain high compliance rates across all Amazon listings.

Resolve compliance cases quickly and effectively.

Prevent listing suppressions through proactive compliance management.

Ensure testing and certifications remain current.

Build strong relationships with manufacturers and testing laboratories.

Keep organized, audit-ready documentation.

Stay ahead of Amazon policy changes and implement improvements proactively.



How to apply?

Only applications through this link will be considered:

title: UK Accounts Preparation Specialist (NOT Bookkeeping) | Php 60K to 75K | UK Clients | Xero Required
description:
UK Accounts Preparation Specialist (NOT Bookkeeping) | Php 60K to 75K | UK Clients | Xero Required



*** Read This First — This Is NOT a Bookkeeping Role***



We are a UK-based firm of accountants supporting hundreds of clients across multiple industries. We are specifically hiring an Accounts Preparation Specialist with real UK statutory accounts experience.

-If your background is mainly bookkeeping, invoicing, or data entry - this role is NOT suitable.

-If you have hands-on experience preparing year-end statutory accounts for UK companies, keep reading.



About the Role

-You will be responsible for preparing complete, accurate, and compliant UK statutory accounts — not just maintaining books.

-You will handle multiple client files each month, working closely with UK managers and accountants to deliver audit-ready financials.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Growing brands rarely break at the idea or the ad. They break in the middle: the order that ships late, the handoff that nobody owned, the warehouse that raised its rates, the process everyone assumes someone else is running. Every new market, product, and launch adds more of that middle, and the brands that keep growing are the ones where someone owns it.



This role owns the middle. You’ll make sure the whole business runs well, from the moment a customer orders to the moment the box arrives. You’ll build the systems, clear the path for the people doing the work, and run the network of fulfillment partners behind every order: knowing who’s out there, keeping the conversations open, and negotiating so our costs keep coming down. The results show up everywhere: faster delivery, lower costs, calmer weeks, and a team that moves quicker.



For a sharp, driven operator who wants their work judged by results, this is a rare opportunity: a central role in how a growing brand runs.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Build and maintain our 3PL network. Keep a living map of fulfillment partners across the markets we serve: who they are, where they ship from, what they handle, what they charge, and how they perform. Know who to call before we need them.



Negotiate all the time, not once a year. Stay in constant conversation with new and existing 3PLs, open negotiations, compare offers, and use each one to push rates, terms, and service levels in our favor. Every point you win drops straight into our margin.



Keep the whole business running. Own the day-to-day operations across fulfillment, customer support, vendors, and internal processes, and make sure nothing important falls between teams.



Build the systems that scale. Turn the way we work into clear processes, checklists, and tools that a growing team can follow without being told twice.



Make teams work as one. Connect marketing, creative, support, and logistics so that work moves smoothly from one hand to the next and blockers get cleared fast.



Own our other partners. Manage the relationships with suppliers, manufacturers, and service providers: performance, costs, contracts, and what happens when something goes wrong.



Run on real numbers. Track the operational numbers that matter, such as delivery times, cost per order, error rates, and margins, and turn them into decisions and savings.



Solve problems before they spread. Catch the small issue early, find the real cause, and fix it permanently, so the same thing doesn’t happen twice.



Keep the team in rhythm. Run a steady working rhythm for a remote, international team, including planning, follow-ups, onboarding, and clear ownership of every task.



Prepare for what’s next. Plan the operations behind new launches, new markets, and new brands before they arrive, so growth doesn’t become chaos.



Keep us in good standing. Make sure we follow the rules that apply to what we make and sell in every market, and that records and contracts are in order.



Move fast without cutting corners. Use AI tools to speed up research, reporting, and routine work, then apply your own judgment to make the final calls.



What we look for



A negotiator’s mindset. You’re comfortable asking for more, you do your homework before you sit down, and you can tell a good offer from one that only looks good. You build relationships that survive hard bargaining.



Systems thinking. You see how the pieces of a business connect, you can tell a one-off problem from a broken process, and you fix the process.



Judgment under pressure. You stay steady when things go wrong, make sound calls with incomplete information, and explain them clearly.



Fluency with numbers. You’re comfortable with costs, margins, and operational metrics, and you use them to d
, not just to report. You can compare fulfillment quotes line by line and spot what’s hiding in the fine print.



Leadership without hierarchy. You get things done through clarity, trust, and follow-through in a small, remote team, not through titles.



Ownership. You treat every process and every problem as yours until it’s solved. You hold yourself to a bar that keeps rising.



Team spirit. You support the best idea, not your own. You take feedback well and give it generously.



Relevant experience. [4+] years running operations for an e-commerce or consumer brand, including sourcing, evaluating, and negotiating with 3PLs or similar partners, and managing remote teams, with results you can show, ideally with the numbers to prove it. Experience in beauty, skincare, or another consumer category is a strong advantage. Excellent English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the best ones get tested.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay well above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Impact across the business. The systems you build and the deals you win touch every team and every customer. You’ll see the whole company run better because of your work.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.



Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, the person who builds how we operate is the person best placed to lead it.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your results speak for themselves.



Before you apply

Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Inside Sales Associate (ISA)
description:

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Eveready Express 



Eveready Express is a well-established U.S. leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution. Founded in 1984, we have built our reputation on honesty, integrity, mutual respect, and a commitment to delivering reliable logistics solutions. 



Our growing team combines virtual and onsite professionals who work together to provide exceptional service, build lasting customer relationships, and drive business growth. 



We are looking for two results-driven Inside Sales Associates (ISAs) with a strong sales mindset, a hunter mentality, and the ability to build relationships with customers in the fast-paced New York and Tri-State logistics market. 



Position Overview 



The Inside Sales Associate is responsible for generating new business, developing existing customer accounts, and increasing revenue and gross profit across the Eveready Express fleet. 



This role combines proactive outbound sales, customer relationship management, and operational coordination. The ISA will work closely with the Dispatch and Operations teams to identify sales opportunities, secure profitable orders, and maximize fleet utilization. 



The ideal candidate is confident, persuasive, persistent, and comfortable communicating with a wide range of business personalities, particularly in the demanding New York City market. This individual must be able to build rapport quickly, identify customer needs, follow up consistently, and convert opportunities into profitable business. 



Key Responsibilities 



1. New Business Development and Prospecting 



Conduct a minimum of 50 outbound calls per day to identify prospects, qualify leads, introduce Eveready Express services, and develop new business opportunities. 



Proactively contact potential shippers, freight brokers, and other businesses requiring trucking, courier, and logistics services. 



Identify and pursue new sales opportunities through prospect lists, CRM records, inbound inquiries, and leads provided by the Sales team. 



Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects through consistent outreach, follow-ups, and relationship-building activities. 



Develop an effective sales approach for engaging decision-makers and establishing relationships with customers in the New York and Tri-State markets. 



Communicate the company's service capabilities, value proposition, and competitive advantages to prospective customers. 



2. Existing Customer Development and Retention 



Maintain regular contact with active customers to strengthen relationships, understand their logistics needs, and identify opportunities for additional business. 



Re-engage inactive and dormant accounts to generate repeat business and recover lost revenue opportunities. 



Identify opportunities to cross-sell and upsell services based on customer requirements. 



Follow up with prospects who have previously requested quotes or expressed interest in Eveready Express services. 



Maintain a professional, responsive, and customer-focused approach to build long-term business relationships. 



3. Inbound Sales and Order Management

 inquiries from prospective and existing customers.

Follow up on outstanding quotes and pending orders to improve conversion rates.

title: Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)

Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)



Company: Eveready Express

About the Role



Eveready Express is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Dispatcher to join our growing logistics team.

Dispatch Operations

title: Virtual Assistant
description:
Cellexia Labs currently serves customers in markets all over the world, with our fastest-growing communities in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. We’re a fully remote, international team, small by design, where everyone owns something real and decisions are made by the people closest to the work.



Behind every ad that works is a lot of careful, unglamorous work: creatives uploaded and named correctly, campaigns checked every morning, numbers pulled and organized, competitors tracked, small problems caught before they cost money. When that work is done well, the media buyers and creatives can spend their time on the decisions that move the business.



This role does that work. You’ll support our Meta advertising and marketing initiatives day to day, keeping things organized, accurate, and moving. It’s a hands-on role with plenty of tasks, and you’ll see exactly how a fast-growing brand runs paid ads from the inside.



For a reliable, detail-minded person who wants to learn digital marketing by working next to people who do it well, this is a rare opportunity: a front-row seat to how a growing brand’s advertising really works.



A few examples of your responsibilities



Support the Meta ad account. Upload and set up ads, apply our naming and tracking conventions, and make sure everything is launched correctly and on time, following clear instructions from the media buyer.



Keep a daily eye on performance. Check campaigns and ad statuses each day, flag disapprovals, spend problems, or anything unusual straight away, and make sure the right person knows.



Pull and organize the numbers. Prepare reports and spreadsheets from Ads Manager and other tools, so the team always has clean, accurate data to make decisions from.



Organize the creative library. Keep ad creatives, scripts, copy, and brand assets sorted, labeled, and easy to find, so no one on the team loses time looking for a file.



Research what’s out there. Track competitor ads, collect examples and ideas from the ad library, and bring back what you find in a clear, usable format.



Support the creative team. Collect briefs, track what’s in progress, and follow up so that creatives get from idea to ad without slipping through the cracks.



Handle marketing admin. Take care of the small tasks that keep marketing running, such as updating trackers, preparing documents, and keeping records current.



Work smarter with AI. Use AI tools to speed up research, organizing, and drafting, and always check the output before it reaches the team.



What we look for



Reliability. You do what you say you’ll do, on time. People on the team can hand you a task and stop thinking about it.



Attention to detail. You catch the wrong budget, the mistyped link, and the file saved in the wrong folder before anyone else does.



Organization. You keep your work and everyone else’s files tidy, logged, and easy to follow.



Fast learning. You pick up new tools and processes quickly, and you ask a good question when you’re stuck instead of guessing.



Clear communication. You report what you’ve done, flag problems early, and write updates that leave no one guessing.



Team spirit. You support the people you work with, take feedback well, and are happy to do the work that helps the team win.



Relevant experience. [1+] years in a virtual assistant, marketing support, or operations role. Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, spreadsheets, and common online tools is a strong advantage, and so is any experience in e-commerce. Excellent written English is essential.



What we offer



Fast decisions, minimal bureaucracy. Your ideas are taken seriously here, whatever your title or tenure, and the good ones get heard.



Competitive pay, set for where you live. We pay above local market norms.



Yearly bonuses of up to 40% of your annual salary. When the brand grows, you share in it.



Monthly and yearly subsidies to do your best work. Every month, we put money toward the things that make you more productive: wellness, focus, hardware and internet upgrades, and more. You know what you need better than we do, so you d
 how to use it.



Real learning. You’ll work next to experienced media buyers, creatives, and marketers and see how paid advertising is run from the inside.



A small team that moves fast. Good ideas get tested quickly.

Work from anywhere. Fully remote, with an international team and the flexibility that comes with it.



A path that grows with the company. As Cellexia Labs scales, people who show reliability and curiosity move into bigger roles in marketing.



The selection process



We care about what you can do, not how polished your CV looks. That’s why our process is built around how you think and work, not just where you’ve worked.



Step 1: Apply. Submit your application and CV through this link: 

Step 2: Online assessments. Right after you apply, you’ll take two short tests: a problem-solving test and a personality test. The problem-solving test shows us how you reason through unfamiliar challenges. The personality test helps us understand how you work and whether the way we operate will suit you.

Step 3: Interview. If your results stand out, we’ll invite you to interview with the team.



We move quickly. The whole process, from application to interview invitation, takes a couple of days.



If you like the role and believe you could excel at it, don’t talk yourself out of applying. A less conventional background is welcome here if your work ethic speaks for itself.



Before you apply



Cellexia Labs is a demanding environment. We hold ourselves to a high bar, and we ask the same of the people who join us. In return, you get real freedom, work that goes live, and a front-row seat to the growth of a brand.



If this sounds like the work you want to be doing, we’d love to hear from you.
