title: Ecommerce Ad Creative Designer (Canva Expert, Non-AI)
description:
We’re a growing UK women’s fashion ecommerce brand looking for a highly skilled Canva designer to join us full-time.



Your strongest skill should be creating ecommerce paid ad creative. Lightroom experience is also highly desirable to recolour existing image assets although training can be provided.



This is not a general VA role. We need someone who can take an idea, reference or set of assets and turn it into strong, polished Meta ads quickly and at scale.



The role

A majority part of your role will be taking existing concepts and product images to recreate and develop them into launch-ready ads in Canva. On the product photography, we also require assistance to rebrighten and refine existing assets using Adobe Lightroom.



You will be given a clear idea or reference rather than starting from a blank page. We need someone who can execute those ideas accurately and make them look great for our brand.



What you’ll be doing

- Creating static Meta ad creatives in Canva

- Adapting reference ads and proven concepts for our brand

- Producing multiple variations of strong ads using different hooks, headlines, product images, customer reviews, layouts and offers

- Creating review, testimonial, product-benefit, comparison, problem/solution, editorial and promotional ads

- Adapting successful concepts across different products and campaigns

- Resizing and adapting creative for different placements

- Working with product photography, UGC and customer reviews

- Keeping Canva files, templates and creative assets organised

- Taking feedback from ad performance and using it to improve future creative



Wider ecommerce & marketing support

As you get to know the business, the role will also include wider ecommerce and marketing support. This could include depending on your experience and interests:

- Website banners and site graphics

- Creative and competitor research

- Reviewing Meta Ad Library for useful concepts and inspiration

- Organising photography, UGC and other marketing assets

- Creating
 graphics

- Checking links, offers and campaign assets before launches

- Paid-ad creative will remain the core of the role.



What we’re looking for

You must have:

- Advanced Canva skills

- Experience creating paid-social advertising for ecommerce or DTC brands

- Knowledge of Adobe Lightroom to make image edits (training can be provided)

- A portfolio containing real ecommerce ad creative

- Strong typography, layout and visual hierarchy

- A good understanding of what makes a paid ad different from a normal social post

- The ability to accurately recreate or adapt a supplied concept

- The ability to work quickly and produce multiple variations

- Excellent attention to detail

- Good written English

- Strong organisation and file management

- The ability to take direction and then work independently

- Excellent reliability and communication



You do not need to be a media buyer or developer.



Experience with Shopify, Meta Ads Manager, simple video editing or wider ecommerce operations would be useful but can be learned.



Important

- If you are primarily a general VA who occasionally uses Canva, this role will not be the right fit.

- We are specifically looking for someone whose strongest skill is ecommerce ad creative.

- The wider ecommerce side of the role can be taught.



Hours

This is intended to be a full-time, long-term position.



We are looking for someone available for approximately 35 hours per week who wants this to be their main regular role rather than fitting it around another full-time position.



There will need to be regular overlap with UK working hours so that you can work closely with our team and respond to creative requests during the working day.



How to apply

Please include:

1) A link to your portfolio showing at least 5 ecommerce paid-social ads that you personally created

2) Tell us which two pieces in your portfolio you think are strongest and why

3) Show us one example, if available, where you recreated or adapted a supplied reference, brief or existing ad concept

4) Tell us how long you have used Canva professionally

5) Confirm your current availability and whether you are looking for one main full-time role

6) Your expected hourly or monthly rate



IMPORTANT: Please apply using at least 5 Apply Points to be considered.



Applications without a relevant ecommerce advertising portfolio/Canva work will not be progressed.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a small creative task using the same type of assets and briefs you would work with in the role.

title: Head of Accounting
description:
Key Responsibilities



Financial Operations & Oversight

- Manage the company’s day-to-day accounting activities, ensuring timely and accurate recording of financial transactions.

- Supervise general ledger management, bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable, and month-end/year-end closings.

- Ensure accounting records are maintained in compliance with company policies and applicable accounting standards.



IFRS Implementation & Compliance

- Apply International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) in all financial reporting processes.

- Prepare and review financial statements in compliance with IFRS, ensuring transparency and accuracy.

- System Management – Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central

- Oversee accounting workflows within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (formerly NAV).

- Ensure system integrity, accuracy of data entries, and effective use of the ERP system to streamline processes.

- Recommend improvements to accounting software usage based on business needs.



AI Automation Management & Quality Assurance (Claude AI)

- Manage, maintain, and monitor existing accounting and financial automations, particularly those developed using Claude AI.

- Perform quality assurance (QA) testing on automated accounting workflows to ensure accuracy, reliability, and consistency of financial data.

- Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve errors or discrepancies in existing automations.

- Review and validate AI-generated financial reports, calculations, and accounting outputs to ensure compliance with company standards.

- Collaborate with relevant teams to maintain, optimize, and improve existing automation processes.

- Ensure proper documentation and continuous monitoring of automated workflows to maintain operational efficiency.



VAT and Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure proper treatment and documentation of VAT on all applicable transactions.

- Monitor changes in local and international VAT regulations and implement necessary updates.

- Liaise with relevant tax authorities or consultants as needed.



Payroll and Salary Processing

- Manage payroll operations, including salary computations, statutory deductions, and disbursements.

- Ensure compliance with Philippine labor laws and tax codes related to compensation and benefits.



Audit Preparation & Coordination

- Prepare audit schedules, reports, and supporting documentation for internal and external audits.

- Collaborate with audit firms and respond to inquiries in a timely and professional manner.

- Implement recommendations from audit findings to strengthen financial controls.



Team Leadership & Mentorship

- Supervise and mentor bookkeepers and junior accountants.

- Provide technical guidance and performance feedback to ensure accuracy and efficiency.

- Foster a collaborative, growth-oriented accounting culture within the team.



Reporting & Advisory

- Generate periodic financial reports and insights for leadership decision-making.

- Provide strategic financial guidance on budgeting, forecasting, and compliance matters.

- Highlight any risks, discrepancies, or process inefficiencies and propose solutions.



Additional Qualifications

- Strong knowledge and practical experience in IFRS, financial reporting, and accounting operations.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (NAV).

- Knowledge and hands-on experience in Claude AI automations, including quality assurance, maintenance, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

- Ability to review, validate, and maintain automated accounting processes while ensuring financial data accuracy.

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and leadership skills.

- Experience managing accounting teams and coordinating financial audits.



How to Apply:

- Interested applicants may send their CV and a link to their portfolio showcasing their best work to 
 Please also indicate your availability, expected monthly rate, and hourly rate, if possible.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Executive Virtual Assistant | Administration & Sales
description:
Balloonaversal Entertainments | Remote | Approximately 20–35 hours per week, with seasonal variation



US$6–$8 per hour (PHP 380 - PHP 508 p/h), depending on skills and experience, plus weekly booking and sales bonuses



Serious about sales. A little less serious about ourselves.



At Balloonaversal Entertainments, we’ve spent 26 years helping families create happy memories with face painting, balloon twisting, magic, pony parties and more.



Behind every delighted birthday child is a fair bit of organising. That’s where you come in.



We’re looking for a warm, confident Executive Virtual Assistant with strong sales skills to help turn enquiries into bookings and keep our administration running smoothly. You won’t need to twist balloon animals, but you will need to keep a few things from getting tangled.



We’re a family business, we love what we do, and we’ve worked with virtual assistants since 2009. We’re looking for another successful, long-term working relationship with someone who becomes a valued part of our team.



About the role



You’ll manage daily administration, communicate with customers and entertainers, coordinate bookings and actively help grow sales.



Most of our customers are everyday Aussie mums and dads organising something special for their children. Our voice is relaxed, friendly and reassuring. You’ll need to chat like a friend while confidently guiding the conversation towards a booking.



We’re looking for someone who takes initiative, asks thoughtful questions and notices the details tucked inside conversations and
s. Someone who can help a busy parent choose the right package, explain the next step and follow through without waiting for instructions at every turn.



We value strong family relationships, honesty, kindness and reliability, and we’re looking for someone who shares those values.



There’s plenty to learn about our packages and processes. You don’t need to know everything on day one, but you do need curiosity, careful listening and a willingness to take notes. “I’ll just remember that” can become a risky party trick.



Hours, location and equipment



- Monday to Friday: Usually 4–6 hours per day, with hours varying throughout the year.

- Working window: All work must be completed between 9:00 am and 5:30 pm Melbourne, Australia time (AEST/AEDT). Start and finish times can be flexible within that window, by agreement.

- Availability: You must be available to arrange your regular working hours within this Melbourne business-day window.

- Location: Remote / work from home, with a quiet workspace suitable for customer calls.

- Equipment: An up-to-date desktop or laptop, a suitable headset for inbound and outbound VoIP calls, reliable high-speed internet, and backup power and internet options.



Typical weekly hours by quarter: average hours



January–March | 21 hours per week

April–June | 18 hours per week

July–September | 21 hours per week

October–December | 30 hours per week 



Additional hours may be available for generating new business.



About you



You’re warm, confident and mature-minded.  

You bring life experience, sound judgement and an outgoing personality. You can put a busy parent at ease and build rapport without sounding as though you’re reading from a script.



You have proven sales skills and formal sales training. 

This is essential. You know how to understand a customer’s needs, recommend suitable options, respond to concerns, follow up and ask for the booking. You’re comfortable leading a sales conversation without making anyone feel pressured.



You notice the little things.  

Names, dates, addresses, package details and customer requests all matter. A Saturday party a
 booked for Sunday is memorable for all the wrong reasons.



You communicate clearly. 

Your spoken and written English is highly fluent, and you can match our friendly Australian brand voice while keeping communication clear and professional.



You’re organised and comfortable with technology.  

You have a good working knowledge of CRMs and learn new workflows readily. Experience with Zoho One, particularly Zoho CRM and Zoho Books, is highly valued.



You take ownership. 

You follow through, raise questions early and suggest solutions. You enjoy working independently while staying connected with the team.



What you’ll be doing



Sales and customer relationships



- Turn warm enquiries into confirmed bookings through friendly, helpful conversations.

- Learn our party and event packages thoroughly so you can confidently recommend suitable options.

- Help parents feel heard, supported and excited about their child’s celebration.

- Follow up enquiries and quotes, keeping clear records and making sure opportunities don’t quietly disappear.

- Generate new business through our existing database and new leads, including outreach and follow-up. Additional hours and weekly sales bonuses also apply to this work.



Administration and coordination



- Manage calendars, entertainer schedules and bookings accurately.

- Prepare quotes, invoices and purchase orders using Zoho Books.

- Keep customer records in Zoho One accurate, complete and up to date.

- Coordinate event details between management, customers and our entertainment team.

- Keep daily administration moving and flag anything that needs attention before it becomes a last-minute scramble.



How to apply



Please include all of the following:



1. Begin your application with BALLOONATIC.  

   It’s our little attention-to-detail check. Consider it your first task, with considerably less paperwork.



2. Tell us about your sales training and skills  

   Include your formal training, relevant sales experience and an example of how you’ve helped turn enquiries into sales.



3. Summarise your administration and CRM experience.

   Tell us about your experience with Zoho One or other advanced CRM systems, along with relevant booking, calendar and financial administration work.



4. Confirm your availability.  

   Confirm that you can work Monday to Friday within 9:00 am–5:30 pm Melbourne time, including Melbourne’s daylight-saving changes, and accommodate the seasonal hours outlined above.



5. Include a short video or audio introduction.

   Share a link to a 1–2 minute introduction using Loom, Google Drive or a similar service. Tell us a little about yourself, why this role appeals to you and what makes you a good fit for Balloonaversal. Please check that your link opens without an access request.



Applications without a video or audio introduction will not be reviewed.



If you enjoy helping families, feel at home in a lively small business and get satisfaction from both a confirmed booking and a beautifully organised calendar, we’d love to hear from you.



Bring your sales skills, your initiative and your sense of humour. We’ll supply the Balloonatics.

title: Senior Architectural Designer - Revit and US Codes
description:
JOB OVERVIEW: (Remote| Mon-Fri | 9 AM - 5 PM EST)



We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Architectural Designer to join our established US architectural firm for a long-term remote position.



This is a true senior-level role for a professional who can take full ownership of projects, solve complex design and technical challenges, and make sound architectural decisions independently. If you have advanced technical expertise in Autodesk Revit, a deep understanding of US building codes, and the ability to develop projects from initial concepts through complete construction documents, we are ready to compensate you for your high-level skills.



SCHEDULE & HOURS:

40 hours per week (Full-Time).

Days: Monday to Friday.

Shift: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (Requires working the night/graveyard shift in the Philippines for live collaboration).



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



Lead and develop architectural design and documentation for US residential and commercial projects.



Translate project requirements and design concepts into highly detailed, coordinated, and construction-ready Revit models and drawing sets.



Oversee space planning, building layouts, exterior design, and intricate architectural detailing.



Review drawings to ensure absolute accuracy, consistency, code compliance, and constructability.



Proactively identify and resolve design conflicts and technical challenges before they impact construction.



Coordinate architectural drawings seamlessly with other disciplines and project team members.



Manage project priorities and deliver top-tier work with minimal supervision.



REQUIREMENTS:



Extensive professional experience as a Senior Architect, Senior Architectural Designer, or highly advanced Revit Drafter.



Advanced proficiency in Autodesk Revit (AutoCAD experience is a plus).



Strong, verifiable knowledge of US residential and commercial construction methods, specifically wood framing, building assemblies, and architectural detailing.



Working knowledge of US building codes and standards (IBC, ADA, fire protection, and life safety).



Total comfort working with US imperial measurements (feet and inches).



Reliable home office setup: High-speed internet connection, webcam, headset, and a computer capable of handling heavy Revit files.



Exceptional English communication skills for daily live collaboration with our US-based team.



Willingness and ability to work a dedicated US Eastern Time schedule (graveyard shift in the Philippines).



WHAT WE OFFER:



Premium salary commensurate with your senior-level expertise.



Long-term stability with a supportive, professional US team.



Opportunity to lead high-quality US residential and commercial projects.



Meaningful professional growth and autonomy in your work.



REQUIRED TO APPLY:

Please include a direct link to your updated portfolio showcasing your Revit capabilities and recent construction document sets (preferably US projects). Qualified candidates will receive a quick follow-up message with a brief intake form as the next step.

title: Digital Marketing, Content Creation & Growth Specialist
description:
WE'RE HIRING!

ABOUT M&C PODCAST AND CREATIVE STUDIO



M&C Podcast and Creative Studio is a professional podcast production and creative studio based in Katy, Texas, USA. We specialize in high-quality podcast production, video recording, photography, content creation, and social media management for entrepreneurs, businesses, and content creators.



We are seeking a creative, proactive, and results-driven Digital Marketing, Content Creation & Growth Specialist to strengthen our digital presence, execute marketing campaigns, generate qualified leads, and contribute to business growth.



IMPORTANT: This is a hands-on role, not just a strategy or coordination position.



The successful candidate must be capable of independently planning, designing, editing, publishing, and managing the majority of our marketing content without relying on separate graphic designers or video editors for routine deliverables.



We are looking for someone who takes initiative, works independently, and delivers measurable results.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy



- Develop and execute monthly and quarterly marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.

- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, customer acquisition, studio bookings, and revenue.

- Research competitors, industry trends, and market opportunities.

- Develop strategies to attract, engage, and convert prospective clients.

2. Content Creation & Graphic Design

3. Video Editing & Short-Form Content



- Independently edit Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube Shorts, and promotional clips.

- Add captions, transitions, graphics, music, and other creative elements.

- Transform existing studio footage into engaging short-form marketing content.

- Create promotional videos highlighting studio services, client experiences, and special offers.

- Collaborate with studio editors only when specialized or advanced editing is required.



4. Social Media Management



- Develop and maintain monthly social media content calendars.

- Create, schedule, and publish content consistently across Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

- Write engaging captions, hashtags, and compelling calls to action.

- Monitor comments, messages, and audience engagement.

- Identify platform trends and opportunities to improve visibility and engagement.

- Ensure content is published on schedule and aligned with marketing objectives.



5. Marketing Campaigns & Customer Acquisition



- Plan, create, launch, and manage digital marketing campaigns.

- Develop promotional campaigns for podcast recording, video production, photography, and other studio services.

- Implement lead generation and customer acquisition initiatives.

- Track campaign performance, conversions, and marketing-generated inquiries.

- Optimize campaigns based on performance data.

- Support
 marketing, promotional offers, and customer retention initiatives.



6. Lead Generation & Business Development



- Research and identify potential clients, including podcasters, entrepreneurs, businesses, and content creators.

- Conduct personalized outreach through approved
, social media, and other channels.

- Identify partnership and collaboration opportunities within the Houston/Katy business community and beyond.

- Maintain an organized database of prospective clients, outreach activities, and follow-ups.

- Support initiatives designed to convert qualified leads into consultations and confirmed studio bookings.



7. Client Communication & Lead Follow-Up



- Serve as an initial point of contact for prospective clients generated through marketing campaigns and outreach.

- Respond professionally and promptly to client inquiries through approved communication channels.

- Provide accurate information about M&C's services, standard packages, and booking process.

- Follow up with prospective clients and nurture leads through the sales process.

- Schedule consultations and coordinate qualified opportunities with studio management.

- Maintain accurate records of client communications and follow-up activities.

- Escalate pricing negotiations, custom proposals, contracts, and complex client concerns to management.



8. Website, SEO & Digital Presence



- Assist with website content updates and optimization.

- Implement basic SEO strategies to improve online visibility.

- Support Google Business Profile optimization and local search marketing.

- Identify opportunities to improve website traffic, inquiries, and conversions.



9. Analytics, Reporting & Accountability



- Monitor social media engagement, audience growth, website traffic, and campaign performance.

- Track qualified leads, outreach activities, inquiries, and marketing-related bookings.

- Prepare weekly performance reports highlighting completed activities, results, challenges, and recommendations.

- Identify underperforming initiatives and propose corrective actions.

- Take ownership of assigned responsibilities and meet established deadlines.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)



The following are initial performance expectations:



- Social Media Content Calendar: Completed monthly and submitted for advance approval.

- Social Media Publishing: 3–4 high-quality posts weekly, adapted across relevant platforms.

- Content Creation: Independently produce required graphics, flyers, and short-form videos.

- Qualified Prospect Research: Identify 15–20 qualified prospects weekly.

- Personalized Outreach: Conduct 10–15 targeted outreach contacts weekly.

- Marketing Campaign Execution: Launch at least one focused marketing campaign monthly.

- Client Communication: Respond promptly to inquiries and maintain consistent lead follow-up.

- Performance Reporting: Submit weekly progress and performance reports.



KPIs will be reviewed periodically based on business priorities, available resources, and performance.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in digital marketing, content creation, and social media management.

- Proven ability to independently design professional graphics, promotional flyers, and marketing materials.

- Strong short-form video editing skills using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar software.

- Proficiency in Canva, Adobe Photoshop, or comparable design tools.

- Experience managing business social media accounts across multiple platforms.

- Demonstrated experience developing and executing marketing campaigns.

- Experience with lead generation, prospect outreach, and customer acquisition.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate professionally with U.S.-based clients.

- Strong copywriting, organizational, and time-management skills.

- Understanding of marketing analytics and performance reporting.

- Ability to work independently, prioritize tasks, and consistently meet deadlines.

- Strong initiative, creativity, attention to detail, and accountability.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience in podcasting, video production, creative agencies, or service-based businesses.

- Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Google Business Profile, and SEO.

- Experience with
 marketing platforms and CRM systems.

- Knowledge of paid social media advertising and conversion optimization.

- Demonstrated success generating qualified leads or increasing revenue.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for someone who is more than a social media manager.



The ideal candidate:



- Takes initiative without constant supervision.

- Can independently turn marketing ideas into completed deliverables.

- Creates professional graphics and edited videos without relying on others for routine content.

- Understands how marketing contributes to customer acquisition and business growth.

- Communicates proactively and follows through on commitments.

- Is creative, resourceful, organized, and results-oriented.

- Takes accountability for the quality and timeliness of their work.

- Is comfortable communicating with prospective clients and supporting business development.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES



Starting Rate: $4.50 USD per hour

Work Schedule: 20 hours per week

Estimated Monthly Compensation: Approximately $390 USD, based on average monthly hours

Performance Review: After the first 90 days



Growth Opportunity: Potential for increased responsibilities, hours, and compensation based on performance and business needs.



HOW TO APPLY



Interested applicants must submit:



1. Resume

Highlighting at least two years of relevant professional experience.



2. Creative Portfolio

Examples of flyers, promotional graphics, and short-form videos personally created.



3. Social Media Experience

Links to business accounts previously managed.



4. Marketing Campaign Results

An example of a campaign personally executed, including measurable outcomes.



5. Lead Generation Experience

A brief explanation of how you have helped a business attract prospective clients.



6. Availability

Confirmation of availability for 20 hours weekly, including some overlap with U.S. Central Time.



7. Compensation Confirmation

Confirmation that you accept the advertised rate of $4.50 USD per hour.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid practical assessment covering graphic design, short-form video editing, marketing strategy, and client communication.



WHY JOIN M&C?



- Work remotely with a growing U.S.-based creative studio.

- Flexible part-time schedule.

- Opportunity to showcase your creativity and contribute directly to business growth.

- Work with a collaborative creative production team.

- Potential for long-term employment and professional growth.



If you are a creative, self-motivated marketing professional who can develop strategies, produce quality content, execute campaigns, and help grow a business, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager
description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER



Salary: $3,500 – $5,000 USD / month (Base) + Aggressive Annual Performance Bonus tied to KPI achievement 

Remote | Full-time | 



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 🎸⚡️



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage). 

Website: 

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.)  High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.)  Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.)  Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.)  Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume  & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: Shopify Store Builder & AI-Powered E-commerce Specialist
description:
We're a fast-growing e-commerce company looking for a skilled, reliable Shopify expert to join our team full-time. You'll build and launch multiple Shopify stores every week, following our internal playbooks and using AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to work faster and smarter.



If you love building stores, move fast, and take pride in quality work, we want to hear from you.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build complete Shopify stores from scratch, following our documentation and workflows

- Configure every essential: domains, payment gateways (including connecting clients' PayPal Business accounts), shipping, taxes and policies

- Customize Shopify themes and troubleshoot front-end and back-end issues

- Create high-converting product pages: descriptions, offers, images and layout

- Use Claude and ChatGPT daily to write product descriptions, generate offer ideas, translate content and speed up repetitive tasks

- Design simple logos and visuals for each store (Canva, Photoshop or AI image tools)

- Translate and adapt product pages between stores and markets

- Fix minor issues independently with HTML, CSS or Liquid

- Act as technical point of contact when integrating third-party apps and tools



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience building Shopify stores (please share links)

- Confident with domain setup, payment gateway configuration and theme customization

- Basic coding skills: HTML, CSS, Shopify Liquid

- Hands-on experience using Claude and/or ChatGPT for e-commerce work

- Image editing and basic logo design skills

- Highly organized and fast: able to handle several store builds per day without cutting corners

- Independent problem-solver who also follows processes carefully

- Good written English



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with multi-language stores

- Familiarity with Shopify apps, automation tools (n8n, Make, Zapier) or AI image tools

- Knowledge of conversion optimization (CRO)



WHAT WE OFFER

- Full-time, long-term position, 100% remote

- 6 days/week, 8 hours/day, with at least 4 hours overlap with European business hours (Central European Time)

- Fast-paced environment where you'll learn modern AI workflows

- Growth opportunities for top performers



HOW TO APPLY

Fill out this form: 

Include links to 2-3 Shopify stores you've built and one example of how you've used Claude or ChatGPT in your work.

Only applicants who complete the form will be considered.



To show you read this post, start your application with the word "PIXEL".



Hiring process: form review > 20-min call > paid test task > offer.

title: Email Marketing Specialist
description:
About us

We are a fast-growing e-commerce brand in the Netherlands and Belgium. We sell through Shopify, and paid social is our main growth channel.
 marketing is the biggest opportunity we haven't tapped yet.



What we're looking for

Not someone who waits for instructions, but a real professional who tells us how it should be done. Someone who knows
 marketing from A to Z and takes it completely off our hands, from strategy to the last pixel. You are the expert, and we follow your advice.



You can be an independent specialist or a small team. Either way, we want a long-term partnership with someone who thinks along with us, takes ownership and shows results.



What you will do for us

- Strategy: d
 which flows, campaigns and segments we need, and in what order.

- Flows: set up and optimize welcome, abandoned cart and checkout, post-purchase, replenishment and winback.

- Campaigns: plan, design and send them.

- Design and build: create on-brand
s that look great on mobile and in every inbox.

- Segmentation and personalization: the right message to the right customer.

- Deliverability: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, list hygiene, and making sure we land in the inbox.

- Testing and improving: ongoing A/B tests with clear takeaways.

- Reporting: a short weekly or monthly report on
 revenue, what's working and the next steps.



Who you are

- You have proven experience with Klaviyo and Shopify.

- You have built flows and campaigns for e-commerce brands that drove measurable revenue.

- You think strategically, and you also do the hands-on work yourself.

- You communicate proactively and come to us with ideas.

- You are comfortable working with Dutch-language content. Experience with the Dutch or Belgian market is a plus.



What we offer

- A long-term partnership with a lot of freedom and trust.

- Direct contact with the founder.

- A growing brand and room to show what you can do.



How to apply

Send us:

1. Examples of
s you have designed and built. This matters most to us. Links or screenshots are fine.

2. One or two results you're proud of, such as revenue from a flow or an improved open or click rate.

3. A short outline of how you would approach your first 30 days with us.



Start your message with the words "A to Z" so we know you read the full post.

title: Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer
description:
We're Hiring: Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer (Remote)



Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern Time

Compensation: $11 USD/hour + 2% commission on every deal closed



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced Real Estate Acquisition Specialist / Closer who can turn qualified seller leads into signed purchase agreements.



This is a phone-focused sales and closing role for someone with real estate industry experience, strong negotiation skills, and a proven ability to build trust with homeowners, handle objections, present offers, and close deals.



You will work directly with homeowners who are considering selling their properties, helping them understand their options and guiding them through the acquisition process with professionalism and care.



Previous real estate industry experience is required. Candidates with experience in real estate acquisitions, wholesaling, or residential property sales are strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities



Conduct phone consultations with qualified homeowners interested in selling.



Prepare and present purchase offers based on company guidelines.



Explain purchase agreements and guide sellers through the contract process.



Negotiate pricing and terms to reach mutually beneficial agreements.



Handle objections, address concerns, and confidently move deals toward closing.



Follow up consistently with sellers until agreements are signed.



Coordinate with lead managers and follow-up specialists to ensure smooth communication.



Maintain accurate CRM records of calls, offers, negotiations, and deal progress.



Track performance metrics, participate in call reviews, and apply coaching feedback.





Requirements

~ At least 3 years of sales experience, preferably in phone sales or closing.

~ Required: Previous real estate industry experience, ideally in acquisitions, wholesaling, or residential property sales. 

~ Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate confidently with U.S. homeowners.

~ Strong negotiation, objection-handling, relationship-building, and closing skills.

~ Ability to handle sensitive seller situations with empathy and professionalism.

~ Coachable, results-driven, organized, and committed to continuous improvement.

~ Strong communication and teamwork skills.

~ Willingness to work Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–7:00 PM Eastern Time.

~ Reliable high-speed internet, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.

~ A Windows or Mac computer. Chromebooks are not accepted.



Compensation

$11 USD per hour base pay

2% commission on every deal closed

This opportunity is ideal for a motivated closer who wants to grow in real estate acquisitions and earn additional income through performance-based commissions.



How to Apply

Please follow the application instructions carefully. To be considered, submit BOTH of the following through your OLJ application:



1. Updated Resume: Provide a link to your resume in PDF format.

2. Voice Introduction: Submit a Vocaroo link to a 1–2 minute recording introducing yourself and discussing your relevant real estate experience.



Important Application Guidelines:

Submit both requirements directly through your OLJ application.

Do not
 your application.

Provide your Vocaroo link only. Do not upload the audio file.



Applications missing either requirement or not following the instructions may not be reviewed.

Attention to detail matters. Please make sure your application is complete and follows all instructions before submitting.

We look forward to hearing from qualified candidates with real estate experience and a strong track record in sales and closing.

title: Funnel Specialist
description:
About The Visionary Group (TVG)



Welcome to The Visionary Group. We are a close knit e-commerce growth team of brand builders, strategists, and marketers. We help companies scale to maximum their true potential by exploring DTC solutions best suit for their stage of business. Founded in 2022, our collection of fast paced tea
mbers is becoming filled with high priority work, which is where you come in!



What this position is responsible for:



We’re looking for a highly analytical and execution-focused DTC Funnel Optimization Specialist who can identify conversion bottlenecks, implement high-impact fixes, and continuously improve the customer journey across our eCommerce client portfolio. This role exists to bridge the gap between paid acquisition and on-site conversion performance, ensuring traffic generated by our Paid Media Strategists converts at the highest possible rate. You’ll own the diagnosis, testing, implementation, and reporting of funnel improvements while helping scale winning conversion strategies across multiple brands.



Requirements/Experience:



- 2+ years of experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), DTC eCommerce, funnel optimization, or Shopify growth operations



- Strong working knowledge of Shopify and DTC customer acquisition funnels



- Experience using tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, or similar analytics platforms



- Hands-on experience building and updating landing pages and pre-sale pages using Replo or similar no-code builders



- Familiarity with quiz funnel platforms such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, or related tools



- Experience implementing and analyzing A/B tests using tools like Convert, GLO, Intelligems, or equivalent testing platforms



- Strong understanding of key eCommerce conversion metrics including LP CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, and funnel conversion flow



- Ability to write high-converting CRO-focused copy including headlines, CTAs, benefit-driven bullets, and trust-building messaging



- Strong analytical thinking with the ability to prioritize opportunities based on impact and effort



- Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple client funnels simultaneously



- Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with Paid Media Strategists and internal stakeholders



- High attention to detail and strong bias toward execution and accountability



- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, performance-driven remote environment



Roles & Responsibilities for this position:



- Conduct monthly audits of each client’s full acquisition funnel, including the transition from ad creative to landing page/PDP, add-to-cart flow, checkout experience, and post-purchase confirmation journey



- Analyze funnel performance data using GA4, Triple Whale, Shopify Analytics, Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity, and related tools to identify drop-off points, friction areas, and conversion opportunities



- Develop and maintain a prioritized “funnel fix queue” for each client based on projected revenue lift, implementation effort, and business impact



- Collaborate closely with Paid Media Strategists to identify and communicate systemic funnel issues, including disconnects between ad messaging and landing page experience



- Build, launch, and optimize pre-sale pages in Replo to support paid acquisition campaigns and improve conversion performance



- Create, update, and maintain quiz funnels using tools such as Octane AI, Shop Quiz, TryNow, and similar platforms

Implement updates to product detail pages (PDPs) using Shopify-native apps and templated modules without requiring custom Liquid development



- Launch and optimize landing pages designed specifically for paid traffic campaigns and conversion-focused customer journeys



- Execute structured A/B testing initiatives using platforms such as Convert, GLO, or Intelligems, ensuring proper setup, tracking, and reporting



- Write and refine conversion-focused copy for headlines, subheads, product bullets, CTAs, badges, and other on-site conversion elements



- Run a minimum of two A/B tests per client each month, continuously iterating based on performance insights and learnings



- Maintain a centralized testing log documenting hypotheses, variants, results, learnings, and next-step recommendations across all client accounts



- Identify winning conversion patterns and scalable best practices, then templatize and implement them across the broader client portfolio



- Own and monitor core funnel performance metrics including landing page CVR, PDP CVR, ATC rate, checkout completion rate, AOV, quiz completion rate, and quiz-to-purchase rate



- Provide weekly funnel performance updates and actionable insights to Paid Media Strategists via Slack



- Contribute funnel performance insights and scorecard data to monthly client reporting deliverables



- Take full ownership of implementation timelines, optimization initiatives, and measurable funnel performance improvements across assigned accounts



Notes:

- Must be available to work CST hours

- ASAP hire - immediate availability preferred

- Must be based in the Philippines



Apply now!

title: Home Care Scheduler
description:
Job Title

Remote Caregiver Scheduler – U.S. Home Care Agency

Phone-Based Scheduling Role – Must Be Comfortable Calling Caregivers

Remote | Philippines | Supporting U.S. Operations



Position Overview

A U.S.-based home care agency is seeking a remote scheduler located in the Philippines to coordinate caregiver shifts and maintain reliable service coverage for clients.



1. This role is responsible for managing caregiver schedules, responding to call-outs, confirming coverage, and communicating with caregivers and internal staff to ensure shifts are filled and services occur as scheduled.

2. The scheduler must be comfortable working in U.S. time zones, communicating frequently by phone and messaging, and resolving scheduling issues quickly and professionally.

3. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple scheduling priorities simultaneously.



Important About This Role

Home care scheduling is a fast-moving operations role.



Caregivers sometimes call out unexpectedly, and clients must still receive care. The scheduler must be comfortable making phone calls, solving coverage problems quickly, and communicating clearly with caregivers and the operations team.



This role is best suited for someone who enjoys problem-solving, coordinating people, and keeping operations running smoothly.



Core Responsibilities

Caregiver Scheduling

- Schedule caregivers for client shifts according to care plans

- Maintain caregiver availability records

- Assign shifts based on qualifications and availability

- Confirm caregiver shift assignments

- Call-Out and Coverage Management

- Respond to caregiver call-outs

- Identify replacement caregivers quickly

- Coordinate shift coverage with available staff

- Update schedule changes in the system



Caregiver Communication

- Contact caregivers to confirm upcoming shifts

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Prepare and lodge the monthly BAS and annual FBT returns

- Manage reporting and analysis for the business using TM1

- Support AR and AP when needed, and support business units across the group as workloads change



MUST-HAVES

- Fluent English, spoken and written (non-negotiable)

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance or a related field

- Proven experience as a Financial Accountant or in a similar role

- Strong month-end, accruals, reconciliations and P&L variance experience

- Knowledge of Australian requirements such as BAS, FBT and AASB 16

- Hands-on ERP experience, ideally Microsoft Dynamics AX

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision and cross-functionally with multiple teams

- Strong Excel and analytical skills, high attention to detail and integrity

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and available 9am to 5pm Sydney time



HIGHLY REGARDED

HOW TO APPLY

title: 3D CAD Industrial & Product Designer
description:
We are seeking an experienced 3D CAD Industrial & Product Designer to join our cutlery brand, specializing in commercial consumer product design, organic modeling, advanced surface design, and product development.

The ideal candidate must combine advanced technical 3D CAD expertise with a strong sense of industrial design, aesthetics, and product design language. We are looking for a creative professional capable of developing visually appealing, distinctive, and commercially successful consumer products while ensuring technical precision and manufacturing feasibility.

Product design skills, aesthetic judgment, and the ability to create a coherent design language are equally important as technical 3D CAD proficiency. We are seeking a designer, not solely a mechanical engineer or CAD technician.



Requirements

•  Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in 3D CAD, industrial design, and consumer product development.

•  Commercial Consumer Product Design (Mandatory): Proven experience designing complete consumer products intended for commercial production and retail markets, combining functionality, ergonomics, aesthetics, and market appeal.

•  Industrial Design & Design Language (Mandatory): Strong aesthetic judgment and understanding of product proportions, visual balance, form development, styling, and brand identity. Ability to create distinctive, visually cohesive products with a recognizable design language.

•  Advanced 3D CAD Modeling: Expertise in organic shapes, complex surface modeling, geometric textures, and detailed 3D product development.

•  Parametric 3D CAD Design: Strong proficiency in parametric 3D CAD modeling, including feature-based design, design history, assemblies, and fully editable solid and surface geometries.

•  Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Strong understanding of manufacturing techniques, particularly laser cutting, CNC milling, and machining processes.

•  Technical 3D CAD Files: Proficiency in creating, managing, and delivering high-quality, production-ready STEP/STP files with accurate solid and surface geometry.

•  Product Development: Proven ability to conceptualize, design, engineer, and prototype complete consumer products, from initial design concepts and aesthetic development to manufacturing-ready 3D CAD models.

•  Portfolio (Mandatory): A professional portfolio demonstrating both technical 3D CAD capabilities and strong industrial design skills, including aesthetically refined consumer products. Portfolios consisting exclusively of mechanical components or engineering assemblies will not be sufficient.

•  Language: Fluency in English is mandatory, with strong communication skills.



Preferred Qualifications

•  Relevant Industry Experience: Previous experience in cutlery, knife design, or knifemaking is highly valued. Alternatively, a strong background in designing high-end consumer products, with demonstrated attention to aesthetics, premium finishes, sophisticated geometries, and refined product design language, is equally desirable.

•   Proficiency in SolidWorks and/or CATIA.

•   Experience developing complex surface textures and ergonomic product geometries.

•   Experience establishing consistent product design languages across product families or collections.

•   Familiarity with prototyping, material selection, and production optimization.



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a creative, detail-oriented 3D CAD Industrial & Product Designer who combines advanced parametric modeling expertise with a refined sense of aesthetics, proportions, ergonomics, and contemporary consumer product design.

The ability to create attractive, distinctive, commercially viable products is just as important as the ability to engineer and manufacture them. The ideal candidate must demonstrate both strong technical execution and genuine industrial design creativity, translating innovative concepts into visually compelling, functional, and production-ready products.

I am a UK company director with a residential property portfolio, a property-management business, several business-development projects and two voluntary Chairman roles.



I am looking for a reliable, organised and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage the administration, financial records, research and follow-up work across these activities.



This is not simply a data-entry position. I want someone who takes ownership of tasks, keeps accurate records, identifies problems and provides concise reports so I can concentrate on decisions and business development.



You should be proactive, dependable, analytical and comfortable working independently. You must be able to recognise discrepancies, maintain an audit trail and ask questions when information is unclear. I value accuracy, sound judgement and completed work more than the number of tasks you claim to handle. 



Main Responsibilities

1. Property & Lettings Administration

• Maintain property, tenant and tenancy records.

• Track rental income, arrears and tenancy renewals.

• Monitor compliance certificates and deadlines.

• Log repairs, obtain quotations and chase contractors.

• Organise property invoices, receipts and documentation.

2. Financial Administration & Bookkeeping Support

• Record rental income and property expenditure.

• Reconcile transaction exports against invoices and accounting records.

• Prepare payment schedules for my approval.

• Track budgets, recurring bills and mortgage payments.

• Identify missing invoices, duplicate charges and unexplained transactions.

• Prepare monthly income, expenditure, cash-flow and arrears reports.

• Organise accounting records for the accountant.

Important: You will not receive bank passwords or unrestricted banking access. I will retain control of bank accounts, payment authorisation and financial commitments. You will work from approved financial exports, invoices and appropriately permissioned accounting software.

3. Business Administration & Research

• Maintain a database of prospective landlord clients and existing contacts.

• Track sales leads, proposals and follow-ups.

• Research UK property investments, rental potential and refurbishment opportunities.

• Research businesses for sale, competitors, suppliers and new commercial opportunities.

• Prepare concise reports and well-organised spreadsheets.

4.  Chairman Support

• Prepare meeting agendas and papers.

• Maintain minutes, action logs and meeting calendars.

• Chase outstanding actions.

• Organise contractor quotations, invoices and maintenance records.

• Track expenditure, insurance and compliance documentation.

• Support AGM administration and routine communications.

6. Executive Support

• Maintain task lists and calendars.

• Organise digital files and documents.

• Prepare draft
s and letters.

• Monitor deadlines and chase outstanding matters.

• Produce a weekly report highlighting completed work, outstanding tasks, problems and decisions required.

Essential Requirements

• Excellent written English.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

• Experience with bookkeeping, financial administration or transaction reconciliation.

• High attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

• Strong research and organisational skills.

• Confidence using Microsoft 365.

• Ability to manage multiple tasks independently.

• Reliable internet connection and suitable computer.

• Discretion when handling confidential financial and personal information.

• Availability during agreed UK working hours.

Experience with Xero, QuickBooks, UK property management or UK accounting practices is desirable but not essential.





Application Instructions

Please answer every question below. Applications that do not answer the practical question will not be considered.

1. Briefly describe your relevant VA, bookkeeping or financial administration experience.

2. Which accounting software, spreadsheets and task-management tools have you used?

3. Have you worked with UK businesses, landlords or property portfolios?

4. What hourly rate do you charge, and what hours can you work in Philippine time?

5. Describe a time you identified an error, discrepancy or missed deadline before it became a bigger problem.

6. Practical question — please answer in your own words, in no more than 150 words:

Practical question – Gas Safety Certificate

You are responsible for helping administer a portfolio of UK rental properties.

The property compliance tracking system shows that a tenant's Gas Safety Certificate (CP12) is due to expire at the end of this month.

You have access to:

• The property and tenant contact details.

• The compliance tracking system.

• Details of the landlord's preferred Gas Safe registered contractor.

• Previous inspection and maintenance records.

What would you do?

Explain the steps you would take from identifying the approaching expiry date through to ensuring the new certificate is obtained, recorded and the compliance system updated.

In your answer, explain:

1. Who you would contact and in what order.

2. How you would arrange access with the tenant and the contractor.

3. What you would do if the contractor could not attend before the expiry date.

4. How you would monitor progress and follow up if appointments were not confirmed or missed.

5. What records you would update and what you would report to the director.

Your answer should be no more than 200 words.

Important: You have authority to coordinate appointments and communicate with tenants and contractors, but you do not have authority to approve additional expenditure or appoint a different contractor without the director's agreement.



To demonstrate that you have read the advert, begin your answer to question 6 with the words “Blue Ledger”.

title: Video Editor
description:
JustSimply Marketing (JSM) is a fast-scaling, fully remote marketing agency based in Ontario, Canada. We help US and Canadian personal brands grow and monetize, from content and video to launches for info products and high-ticket programs. We've worked with Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.



TEAM VISION

YouTube is where our clients build trust at scale and where viewers turn into buyers. The video team exists to make every upload hold attention. Editors who drive results grow with the team under the Video Editor Manager.



THE ROLE

You own the edit on our clients' YouTube channels: 8-20 minute long-form videos plus the Shorts that feed them. You shape raw footage into stories that keep viewers watching, using pacing, visuals, subtitles and sound design to protect retention from the first second to the end screen.



You report to the Video Editor Manager. You work with scriptwriters, thumbnail designers, short-form editors and the Social Media team. You are judged on retention, watch time and CTR, not on polish for its own sake.



WHO THIS IS FOR

You open YouTube Studio before you open your inbox.

You know where viewers drop off and you cut to stop it.

You follow algorithm changes because they change how you edit.

You want to grow your craft on channels that matter.

This is not for you if you want to polish for weeks, wait for perfect direction, or avoid feedback on your numbers.



WHAT WE OFFER YOU

Full-time, fully remote work, open worldwide, with flexible hours.

Edit for high-profile personal brands like Danny Singson, Dr. Nae and Shaun T.

A growth path inside the video team as you prove results.

Fast decisions and zero bureaucracy.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU

Edit long-form YouTube videos (8-20 min) and Shorts built for retention.

Build strong openings and pattern interrupts that hold attention through the whole video.

Own storytelling, transitions and motion graphics in every edit.

Optimize pacing, visuals, subtitles and sound design.

Cut Shorts from long-form uploads to drive viewers back to the channel.

Review video performance in YouTube Studio and bring what you learn into the next edit.

Use AI tools like Descript for transcripts, rough cuts and cleanup to ship faster. Tools like Opus Clip can help with clipping.

Work async in Slack and 
, and store files in Google Drive.

Stay current with YouTube trends and algorithm changes.



REQUIREMENTS

A portfolio of YouTube edits (long-form and Shorts). Before/after examples are welcome.

A clear understanding of audience retention and CTR.

Skilled in color grading, sound editing and motion graphics.

Fluent in Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro. CapCut is useful for Shorts.

AI-forward: Descript or similar AI editing tools are already part of your workflow.

Nice to have: DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, SEO, analytics and basic thumbnail skills.



RESULTS

In your first 90 days:



Your edits run on a consistent weekly publishing schedule for your channels [confirm].

Average view duration on your videos beats each channel's starting baseline.

Every long-form video you edit ships with Shorts cut from it.

You deliver a written retention review for each video you edit, with changes for the next one.

Revision rounds drop as you learn each client's brand and style.



LOCATION AND SCHEDULE

Fully remote, open worldwide.

Flexible hours, with enough overlap with JSM's core hours 6:00 AM-2:00 PM EST

Deadlines are firm. Channels publish on schedule, so your edits do too.



JOB TYPE

Full-Time



COMPENSATION

Competitive salary, paid monthly.
USD



HOW WE WORK

Results over hours: output counts, not time online.

Extreme ownership: yours means yours, end to end.

High accountability, low ego: own the miss, fix it.

Growth over perfection: ship, learn, improve.

title: Executive Assistant (Procurement & Bids)
description:
Job summary:

Be the CEO's right hand on public-sector bids. Own every deadline, document and submission, and use Claude to keep it all on track.



Meet Mosaic Effect:

Mosaic Effect is an expert-led privacy, cybersecurity and AI governance consultancy. We win most of our work through public-sector procurement: federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector tenders, supply arrangements, vendor rosters, and contract roles placed through staffing agencies.



The machinery is already built: daily portal and
 sweeps, one opportunity tracker, a stage-gated proposal process, templates, and a submission guide for every portal we use.



The role:

You are the CEO's executive assistant for everything procurement. You own the calendar and the paperwork: no deadline missed, every addendum read the day it posts, every submission in early, complete and on the record.

You take instructions and carry them through precisely. You don't write the technical substance of proposals; the CEO and our consultants do that. You make sure it comes together, gets checked and goes in on time.

You report directly to Sukhpreet Singh, CEO, and work with our consultants, staffing agencies and public-sector buyers.



Who this is for

• You follow instructions to the letter, and you ask when something is unclear instead of guessing.

• You can hold a dozen close dates in your head and never drop one.

• You read the fine print in a solicitation before anyone asks you to.

• You'd rather be done two days early than submit at the last minute.

• You already use Claude or similar AI tools every day, and you always check their work.

• You keep confidential information confidential.



What we expect from you

The work follows each bid from first sighting to final debrief.



1. Find and log opportunities (daily and weekly)

    ◦ Run the daily procurement digest (portal scrapes, bid-notice
s, agency requisitions) and log what's new in the opportunity tracker.

    ◦ Run the weekly procurement pulse across federal, provincial, municipal and broader-public-sector sources for privacy, cybersecurity and AI-consulting work.

    ◦ Coordinate the portal assistant's weekday sweeps of login-only portals. A portal nobody reached is logged as "not checked", never "nothing found".

    ◦ Track signals that aren't bids yet: job postings that could become contracts, upcoming vendor rosters, contract-award intelligence from access-to-information requests, and loss debriefs.



2. Qualify and plan

    ◦ Prepare a one-page bid brief and a compliance matrix for each opportunity: mandatory requirements, scoring, insurance, security, certifications, references and submission method.

    ◦ Flag hard blockers early (insurance limits, WSIB, ISO 27001, clearances, certifications, vehicle-holder-only eligibility) and bring each to the CEO as a go/no-go decision.

    ◦ Build each bid's timeline backward from the close and hold the T-48-hour tripwire: everything is complete two days before close, or the CEO hears about it that day.



3. Run bid production

    ◦ Set up the bid folder from templates and keep documents versioned (v0.x drafts, v1.0 approved).

    ◦ Collect inputs on time: consultant résumés and consents, references and referee consent, corporate documents, insurance certificates, signatures and forms.

    ◦ Run the completeness check against the compliance matrix before review, and track feedback through the green-light gates.

    ◦ Send buyer questions within the question period once the CEO approves them. Download every addendum and Q&A the day it posts and update the matrix.



4. Submit and keep records

    ◦ Assemble the final package and, after CEO approval, submit through the correct portal or by
 at least 24 hours before close.

    ◦ Save proof of submission (receipts, confirmation numbers, screenshots) and file the submitted set.

    ◦ Track outcomes, request a debrief on every loss and log the lessons.



5. Agencies, rosters and registrations

    ◦ Manage staffing-agency requisitions: right-to-represent forms, résumé versions and availability confirmations, with a strict one-person, one-channel rule per requisition.

    ◦ Maintain vendor registrations and portal accounts: CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, BC Bid, Alberta Purchasing Connection, SaskTenders, Biddingo, bids&tenders and others. Track renewal dates, document fees and supplier profiles.

    ◦ Keep corporate compliance documents current and ready to attach: certificate of status, insurance certificates, WSIB/WorkSafeBC, security clearance records and supplier numbers.



6. Report

    ◦ Keep the opportunity tracker current every day: stage, close date, next action and owner.

    ◦ Send the CEO a short daily status: what closes in the next 14 days, what's blocked and what needs a decision.

    ◦ Keep an accurate work log. If it isn't logged, it didn't happen.



Working with AI and Claude

AI runs a large part of our daily machinery, and Claude is the main tool you'll work with. You direct it, check it and own the result.

• Use Claude to summarize solicitations, draft compliance matrices and bid briefs, and spot mandatory requirements.

• Use Claude to draft buyer and agency
s, daily status notes and tracker updates for the CEO's approval.

• Run and supervise the AI-assisted daily digest and portal sweeps, and confirm each source was actually checked.

• Check every AI output against the source documents before it's used. AI drafts; you verify.

• Give clear, specific instructions to Claude, and improve the prompts and checklists the team relies on.



Requirements

• Exceptional organization and deadline discipline across many parallel close dates.

• Careful reading of solicitation documents: mandatory requirements, evaluation criteria, forms, and insurance and security clauses.

• Strong Word and Excel skills: tracked changes, document assembly, PDF packaging and trackers.

• Clear, concise written English for drafting
s to buyers and agencies.

• Daily, hands-on use of Claude or similar AI tools, with the habit of checking their output.

• Discretion with confidential commercial information.

• Can work EST Timezone.



Nice to have

• 2+ years in executive assistance, bid or proposal coordination, procurement administration or contract administration, ideally with Canadian public-sector tenders.

• Hands-on use of Canadian procurement portals such as CanadaBuys/SAP Business Network, MERX, Bonfire, Ariba, Jaggaer or BC Bid.

• Familiarity with federal supply arrangements and methods of supply (TBIPS, TSPS, SBIPS, ProServices), standing offers and vendor-of-record arrangements.

• Exposure to privacy, cybersecurity or IT consulting procurement.

• Experience with staffing-agency requisitions and right-to-represent processes.



Results

• Zero missed deadlines and zero late or incomplete submissions.

• Every addendum and Q&A downloaded and reflected in the bid within one business day of posting.

• A go/no-go decision on every live opportunity within two business days of intake.

• Every submission in at least 24 hours early, with proof on file.

• A tracker that's accurate at any moment, with no "unknown" status older than a week.

• A debrief requested on every loss.



How we work

• The CEO approves anything that leaves the company: submissions, prices, signatures, declarations, and
s to buyers or agencies. You prepare each one so it only needs a yes.

• Portal logins live in a password manager. Credentials are never shared by
 or stored in documents.

• Everything lives in one shared folder, one tracker and one log.



How to apply

Interested?
 
 and attach:

• A short video introduction

• Your resume

• Your portfolio or work samples (for example, bid trackers, compliance matrices or submission packages you've managed, with confidential details removed)
