title: Brand Strategist – Buyer Avatar Research + Full Brand Identity (DTC Supplements, Arrae-level)
description:
I run Lenire, a new Dutch supplement brand for women who get bloated and get cramps around their period. Two products (Unbloat and Ease), natural capsules, sold online at a premium price. I'm looking for one experienced brand strategist who takes the brand from research to a finished brand book: who the buyer is, how she talks, what the brand stands for, and how it looks, sounds and behaves everywhere.



The bar is Arrae (
), Norse Organics (
), Semaine and Aesop. If you don't immediately see why those brands feel expensive and trustworthy, this job is not for you.



This is a senior role. You have built at least 3 brands end to end, ideally in DTC wellness, supplements, skincare or femcare.



Phase 1 – Buyer avatar (week 1–2)



- Build the full buying persona of a Dutch woman aged 22 to 45 who gets bloated and gets cramps around her period: her day, her month, what she has tried, what she's afraid of, what she says to her friends, what finally makes her buy, and what makes her stay.

- Voice-of-customer research: Reddit, TikTok comments, Amazon and 
 reviews,
 groups, forums, competitor reviews. Not guesses, actual quotes. You deliver a VoC document with 100+ real quotes sorted by pain, desire, objection and language.

- Jobs-to-be-done, buying triggers, objections and the emotional job the product does.

- Competitor and category map: who she buys from now (pharmacy brands, teas, painkillers, foreign DTC brands), what they promise, where the gap is.



Phase 2 – Brand strategy (week 2–3)



- Positioning statement and brand promise, written in her language.

- Brand story, mission, values that actually mean something (not "empowerment" and "self-care").

- Messaging hierarchy: the one-liner, the three core messages, the proof points, the objection handlers.

- Tone of voice guide with do's and don'ts and 20+ example lines for ads, product pages,
s and social.

- Naming system for products and bundles, and how we talk about dosage, ingredients and results without medical claims (EU food supplement rules; I'll give you the claims guide, you make the copy rules).

- Offer and pricing architecture: single, duo, subscription, and how to present them.



Phase 3 – Visual identity (week 3–5)



- Logo (wordmark; we have a direction in a Garamond-style serif, you refine or challenge it).

- Colour system, typography, grid, iconography, photography and illustration direction, packaging direction for a flat round tin.

- Art direction for product photos, UGC content and AI-generated visuals so every creator we hire produces the same look.

- Mockups: tin, website hero, product page, Instagram grid, ad examples,
 header, shipping box or mailer.

- Figma source files, exported assets and a complete brand book (PDF + Notion or Figma) that a freelancer can pick up without asking me anything.



What you must be good with:



- Figma at a professional level. Canva is not enough for this role.

- Research tools and methods: you know how to pull real customer language fast (Reddit, TikTok, review mining, AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT used properly).

- Copywriting: you write the brand lines yourself, in plain human English. No three-word slogans, no mirror phrases, nothing that reads like AI wrote it. Dutch is a plus, not required.

- DTC commercial sense: you understand ads, landing pages, AOV, subscription and retention, and you design a brand that sells, not just a brand that looks nice.



What I expect from you:



- You own the process. You come with a plan, deadlines and questions, not the other way round.

- Taste. You know the difference between "clean" and "premium".

- Honesty. If my idea is weak, say it and show a better one.

- Clear written communication and weekly progress updates.



How we work:



- Fixed-price project with milestones per phase. Tell me your price per phase and your total.

- Start with a paid test: the buyer avatar and VoC document for Lenire (phase 1). If it's excellent, you continue with phases 2 and 3.

- Reachable on weekdays in Netherlands daytime (CET). Slack or WhatsApp, files in Google Drive, Notion and Figma.

- I run several brands. If this goes well there is a second and third brand waiting.



How to apply:



1. Send 2 or 3 complete brand projects you led yourself: brand book or case study, with the research, strategy and visual identity. Links only, no attachments. Tell me exactly which parts were yours.

2. Write 5 sentences on why 
 feels like a premium brand and what you would do differently for a menstruation brand in the Netherlands.

3. Your price for phase 1 (buyer avatar + VoC) and a rough total for all three phases.



Applications without brand books or case studies will not be read.



To make sure you've read this whole post, start your application with the word SAFFRON. Applications that don't start with that word will be ignored.

title: Creative Content Editor / E-commerce Creative Assistant
description:
**E-commerce Creative Editor - Part-Time**



We are looking for a creative, fast and reliable **E-commerce Creative Editor** to join **Yakatoshi & Co.**, a premium travel brand selling innovative collapsible luggage.



This is not a traditional social media manager role.



We are looking for someone who can take raw footage, UGC videos, product photography and existing content and turn it into multiple high-quality advertisements and creative variations for paid social media.



Our goal is to build a consistent creative testing system, not spend an entire day perfecting one simple video.



### Hours



Initially around **10 hours per week**.



Hours are flexible and there is potential for the role to grow as the company grows.



### What you will be doing



Your responsibilities will include:



- Editing short-form video ads for Instagram,
, TikTok and Amazon

- Turning one piece of footage into multiple different ad variations

- Creating different hooks, openings and endings

- Editing UGC creator footage

- Adding captions, graphics, music and simple motion graphics

- Creating 15-second, 30-second and longer versions of advertisements

- Creating different CTA and promotional versions

- Creating seasonal versions for Black Friday, Christmas, New Year and other campaigns

- Creating simple image advertisements where required

- Resizing and adapting content for different platforms

- Organising our content library

- Helping maintain a consistent pipeline of new advertising creatives

- Researching successful advertisements from competitors and other e-commerce brands

- Suggesting new hooks, angles and creative ideas



### Example of how we work



We may give you one video showing our collapsible suitcase.



Rather than producing only one advertisement, we want someone who can turn that footage into multiple different creative angles.



For example:



- "Your suitcase shouldn't take up half your wardrobe"

- Small apartment / storage problem

- Product feature-focused ad

- Travel-focused ad

- Comparison ad

- Packing-focused ad

- Promotional/discount version

- Different opening hooks

- Different CTAs

- Different lengths



The main body of the footage may sometimes remain similar, while the hook, captions, structure, CTA or offer changes.



We want to test lots of creative ideas and learn what performs best.



### Speed and efficiency are important



We care about quality, but we also care about output.



We are **not looking for an editor who spends 8-10 hours editing one relatively simple 15-30 second UGC advertisement**.



For organised footage and a clear creative brief, we expect you to be able to efficiently produce multiple useful advertising creatives and variations.



Some advertisements will require more editing than others, so we do not expect every video to take the same amount of time.



However, we want someone who understands the importance of **creative volume and testing in e-commerce advertising**.



### Skills we are looking for



You should have experience with:



- CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or similar editing software

- Short-form social media advertising

- UGC-style video editing

- Creating strong hooks

- Captions and motion graphics

- Understanding pacing and viewer retention

- Basic graphic design

- Creating multiple variations efficiently from existing footage



Experience working with **e-commerce brands** is strongly preferred.



Experience creating Meta/Facebook advertising creative is a major advantage.



### What we are NOT looking for



We are not looking for someone who simply creates attractive Instagram posts.



Advertising creative needs to:



- Capture attention quickly

- Highlight a problem or desire

- Clearly demonstrate the product

- Keep people watching

- Communicate the offer

- Encourage people to purchase



You will not be responsible for managing our advertising campaigns.



Your main responsibility will be producing the creative that our advertising team can test.



### Who you will work with



You will work directly with the founder.



We will provide:



- Raw footage

- Product photography

- UGC creator videos

- Scripts

- Creative briefs

- Advertising concepts

- Examples of advertisements we like

- Brand assets



We also want someone who is proactive and comfortable suggesting their own creative ideas.



### Trial



We will begin with a **paid trial project**.



We will provide existing footage and ask you to create several different advertising variations from it.



If we work well together, this will become an ongoing part-time position.



### How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Examples of short-form advertisements you have edited

3. Examples of work for e-commerce brands, if available

4. Which editing software you use

5. Your hourly rate

6. Your weekly availability



Please also answer these questions:



**1. If we provided you with organised raw footage, UGC clips, product photos and a clear brief, approximately how many distinct ad creatives or useful ad variations would you expect to produce in 10 hours?**



Please explain what level of editing you are assuming.



**2. If we gave you one 30-second UGC video for a suitcase, how would you turn that footage into 5-10 different advertisements without needing to reshoot the footage?**



**3. What do you think makes a good e-commerce advertisement different from a normal social media video?**



Please start your application with the word **YAKATOSHI** so we know you have read the full job description.

title: Structural Steel & Metal Fabrication Estimator
description:
ABOUT US

Structmate is an Australian quantity surveying and estimating consultancy based in Sydney. We provide take-offs, Bills of Quantities and tender estimates for builders and trade contractors across Australia.



We are expanding into steel and metal fabrication estimating and are looking for an experienced estimator to join our support team on an ongoing basis.



THE ROLE

You will prepare quantity take-offs and first-pass cost estimates for steel fabrication tenders, working directly with our Australian lead estimator, who reviews all work before it goes to the client.



Typical scope includes:

- Structural and secondary steelwork

- Platforms, stairs, ladders, walkways and handrails

- Support frames, brackets and equipment supports

- Security caging, gates, barriers and enclosures

- Architectural and miscellaneous metalwork

- Mining and industrial fabrication



Your responsibilities:

- Review tender drawings and specifications

- Measure steel quantities and convert to tonnage by member type (UB, UC, PFC, SHS, RHS, CHS, angles, flat bar, plate)

- Measure handrails, grating, mesh and cladding (lm / m2)

- Count connections, base plates, cleats, bolts and fixings

- Calculate surface areas for hot-dip galvanising and protective coatings

- Prepare a first-pass costing in our Excel template (materials, fabrication hours, coatings, transport)

- List any drawing discrepancies, missing information and suggested exclusions/clarifications

- Keep take-off records neat, marked-up and traceable



REQUIREMENTS

- Minimum 3 years' experience in steel / metal fabrication estimating or take-off

- Strong knowledge of steel sections and weights (Australian standards / InfraBuild-OneSteel tables preferred)

- Confident with at least one take-off tool: Bluebeam, PlanSwift, CostX or similar

- Advanced Excel

- Able to read structural and shop/fabrication drawings accurately

- Good written English and reliable communication

- Able to work at least partly within Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT)

- Strict confidentiality – you will be required to sign an NDA



HIGHLY REGARDED

- Experience estimating for a fabricator (not just a builder)

- Tekla Structures or Advance Steel experience

- Knowledge of fabrication labour hours per tonne

title: Resourceful Developer | AI, APIs & Business Automation
description:
A repetitive task is eating hours. Two systems won’t talk to each other. An AI tool looks promising, but nobody knows whether it can actually do the job.



You’re the person who investigates, writes the code, and gets a dependable solution running.



Real Hires is hiring a full-time developer to work directly with the founder on practical software and automation projects. This is a remote position paying $1,500 USD per month for 40 hours per week, with overlap with New York working hours.



We want to see how you solve problems. You read documentation, test unfamiliar tools, ask useful questions, and come back with a recommendation. You can d
 when to use an existing service and when custom code is the better answer.



The work involves building complete web applications: interfaces, backend services, SQL databases, authentication, deployment, and maintenance. You’ll connect APIs, collect information from external sources, clean inconsistent records, resolve duplicates, and track sources and updates. You’ll also build search, matching, and ranking features that make that information useful.



AI belongs in the solution when it earns its place. You should be able to use language models for extraction, classification, and analysis, measure the quality of their output, and handle mistakes or uncertainty. Your automations should recover from temporary failures, leave clear logs, and keep API and model costs under control.



Bring strong Python or JavaScript/TypeScript skills and examples of web applications you’ve shipped. You should be comfortable using AI development tools while understanding and troubleshooting the code they produce. We need someone who follows through, flags blockers early, and takes responsibility for keeping the finished system working.



Apply through OnlineJobs with one project that shows how you think. Include a working link or repository, your personal contribution, the hardest problem you encountered, and how you checked that the solution worked. Tell us your availability and overlap with New York hours.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical assessment.

title: Full-Stack Engineer | Search & Data Applications
description:
An API goes down. The same record arrives twice. Yesterday’s information is out of date. A model gives a convincing answer that turns out to be wrong.



Can the application you built handle it?



We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys making complex information useful and making the software around it dependable.



At Real Hires, you’ll own applications that collect, organize, search, and analyze information. You’ll work directly with the founder, help d
 how projects should be built, and take them through release and ongoing improvement.



The engineering challenge



1. Bring information in through APIs, web-data collection, and external integrations.

2. Organize it in SQL databases, handling duplicate and conflicting records while preserving sources and freshness.

3. Make it accessible through usable interfaces, search, filters, matching, and ranking with clear reasons behind results.

4. Add language-model extraction, classification, or analysis where useful, and evaluate accuracy and uncertain outputs.

5. Keep the whole application running: backend services, authentication, deployment, background processing, retries, logging, monitoring, and cost controls.



The person



You’re a capable Python or JavaScript/TypeScript programmer with experience shipping complete web applications. You trace unexpected results to their cause, test assumptions, and verify your fixes. You research unfamiliar technology independently and explain your recommendations clearly.



You also notice what’s missing, communicate blockers early, and finish the work. AI coding tools can be part of your process; understanding and maintaining what you ship remains your responsibility.



The practical details



Full-time and remote. $1,500 USD per month. 40 hours per week, with overlap with New York working hours.



Apply through OnlineJobs with a project link. Explain the part you built yourself, a difficult technical failure you resolved, and the evidence you used to confirm it was fixed. Include your availability and New York hours overlap. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid practical assessment.

title: Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager |Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote
description:
Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager



Multi-Store International E-Commerce | Remote



We are a fast-growing international e-commerce company operating multiple Shopify stores across several countries and processing significant transaction volumes through multiple payment providers.



We are looking for a highly capable Senior Financial Controller / Finance Manager to professionalize and take ownership of our finance function.



This is NOT a junior bookkeeping position.



We already have finance/accounting activities taking place inside the company. We need a senior finance professional who can ensure that our numbers are accurate, our controls are strong and management has reliable financial information for decision-making.



Your Mission



Build a finance function that the founder can trust.



You will assess our current finance processes, identify weaknesses, improve controls and reporting, and oversee the people performing recurring finance work.



Responsibilities



* Own financial reporting and financial accuracy

* Review and improve our current finance processes

* Oversee bookkeeping and accounting workflows

* Review reconciliations across banks and payment processors

* Ensure Shopify/order data reconciles correctly with financial records

* Monitor payment processor settlements and fees

* Review supplier payments and COGS

* Improve expense categorization and controls

* Monitor refunds, chargebacks and payment-related losses

* Produce reliable monthly P&L reporting

* Produce consolidated and store-level management reporting

* Develop cash-flow reporting and forecasting

* Build budgets and forecasts

* Identify unusual financial movements and discrepancies

* Establish appropriate approval and financial control processes

* Review the work of junior finance/accounting team members

* Improve month-end closing procedures

* Work with external accountants, tax advisers and other specialists where required

* Help management understand profitability and financial performance

* Identify opportunities for financial automation and better systems



E-Commerce Complexity



Experience with high-volume e-commerce is strongly preferred.



Our environment may include:



* Multiple Shopify stores

* Multiple currencies

* Multiple countries

* Stripe

* Shopify Payments

* PayPal

* Klarna and other payment methods

* Refunds

* Chargebacks

* Supplier payments

* Advertising spend

* FX

* Payment processor fees



You should be comfortable reconciling complex transaction flows rather than only traditional invoice-based businesses.



What We Are Looking For



* Strong accounting/finance foundation

* Significant experience in financial control, finance management or senior accounting

* Excellent reconciliation skills

* Strong management reporting ability

* Experience creating or improving financial controls

* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

* Experience with accounting software such as Xero or QuickBooks

* High attention to detail

* Strong analytical ability

* Ability to investigate discrepancies independently

* Ability to review and challenge the work of others

* Strong written English



CPA/ACCA/CIMA or comparable professional qualifications are highly valued but not automatically required if your experience is exceptional.



What We Are NOT Looking For



This is not suitable for someone whose experience is primarily:



* Data entry

* Basic bookkeeping

* Accounts payable only

* Virtual assistance

* Producing reports without understanding the underlying numbers



We need someone capable of owning and controlling a finance function, not simply processing transactions.



What Success Looks Like



Management can confidently answer:



* How profitable are we?

* Which stores are most profitable?

* What is our real COGS?

* Where is our cash?

* What are our payment processor balances?

* Are all transactions reconciled?

* What are our major financial risks?

* How are actual results performing against forecast?



And most importantly: management can trust the answers.



Application



Please answer:



1. What is the largest company, measured by annual revenue or transaction volume, for which you have personally managed or controlled finance?

2. Describe the most complex reconciliation environment you have worked with.

3. Have you worked with Shopify, Stripe, PayPal or similar payment processors? Explain exactly what you were responsible for.

4. Tell us about a significant financial discrepancy or control problem you personally discovered. How did you find it and what happened?

5. Which financial reports did you personally prepare or review each month?

6. Have you managed or reviewed the work of other accountants/bookkeepers? How many?

7. Which accounting qualifications do you hold?

8. Which accounting systems are you strongest with?

9. What is your current availability and expected monthly compensation for a full-time position?



Begin your application with FINANCIAL CONTROL.

title: PPC Specialist
description:
**Amazon PPC Specialist - Part-Time**



We are looking for an experienced Amazon PPC specialist to manage and grow the advertising for our premium travel brand, Yakatoshi & Co.



We currently sell a premium collapsible carry-on suitcase on Amazon US and are looking for someone who understands Amazon advertising beyond simply adjusting bids and trying to reduce ACoS.



**Hours**



 2 hours per day, Monday-Friday.



There is potential for the role and hours to grow as the brand expands.



**Responsibilities**



- Manage and optimise Amazon Sponsored Products campaigns

- Build and improve automatic, broad, phrase and exact-match campaigns

- Conduct keyword research and competitor/ASIN research

- Analyse search-term reports

- Identify profitable keywords and move them into appropriate campaigns

- Identify wasted ad spend and introduce negative keywords where appropriate

- Manage bids, budgets and placements

- Monitor CPC, CTR, CVR, ACoS and TACoS

- Help improve organic keyword ranking through PPC strategy

- Identify opportunities to increase sales rather than simply minimise advertising costs

- Provide a simple weekly performance report

Experience with luggage, travel products or competitive consumer-product categories would be a bonus.

We want someone who can look at the data, identify opportunities and make intelligent decisions about where advertising money should be spent.

title: Compliance Officer (AI and Data), Long-Term Partnership Opportunity
description:
Quick note: Before sending in your application, please make sure to read all the instructions in our "How to Apply" section. Any applications with missing items from our instructions will not be entertained. 



About MSTR



MSTR (
) is an AI software company based in the Netherlands and an Anthropic partner. We build custom AI software for Dutch businesses, run programs that bring AI into daily use, and ship our own products.



We are 20+ people, with a customer-facing team in the Netherlands and a remote development team in the Philippines. Our clients include municipalities, accountants, law firms and enterprise clients. They need to know their data is safe and that our products meet European rules, so we are hiring someone whose full focus is compliance.



This is a long-term career opportunity



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, not find their next gig. We invest in our people's growth and increase responsibility as you develop.



Location and type



- Remote

- Full-time, 40 hours per week, 14:00 to 23:00 Philippine time (overlapping with Netherlands business hours)

- Long-term contractor position



What you will do



You make sure every product we ship is compliant and properly documented. You report to our Head of Operations and work closely with our Head of Technology and Head of Product.



- Compliance documentation: keep it current for every product and client project, including data flows, processing records, security measures and risk assessments

- Client agreements: prepare data processing agreements and answer client security questionnaires

- Regulation checks: check products against GDPR and the EU AI Act, and flag gaps early to the product owner

- Internal policies: maintain our policies on data retention, access management and i
 response, and make sure teams follow them

- AI model register: track which AI models and hosting locations each product uses, so we can answer client questions fast

- Audits: support audits and certification work, such as ISO 27001



We are an AI company, and we want someone who helps our clients use AI safely and with confidence. That doesn't mean saying yes to everything. Sometimes good advice is "yes, and here's how." Sometimes it's "not like this." We value both, and we want you to speak up when something is at risk.





What we are looking for



Must-have:

- 2+ years of experience in compliance, data privacy, IT audit or information security

- Hands-on experience with GDPR, such as DPIAs, processing records or data processing agreements

- You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in your daily work, and can show us how

- A precise, structured way of working

- Excellent English communication, especially written

- Comfortable asking developers the right questions and turning technical answers into clear documentation





Nice-to-have:

- Hands-on experience with Claude and how it handles data, connectors and Anthropic's terms. This will make your application stand out.

- Working knowledge of the EU AI Act

- A certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, AIGP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or similar

- Experience at a software or SaaS company

- Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS) and how AI models are hosted

- Experience working with European clients



If you already know Claude well, that's a big advantage. If you don't, we will teach you. We are an Anthropic partner and work with Claude every day, so you'll learn how Claude handles data, how connectors work and what Anthropic's terms say. What we need from you first is a solid compliance foundation and real curiosity about the tools.



AI tools are welcome. We are an AI company. If you use Claude, ChatGPT or similar tools to draft policies, compare regulations or prepare questionnaire answers, tell us how. We would rather hire someone who uses AI well than someone who avoids it.



What we offer



- Long-term partnership: we are investing in your future with us

- Build something from scratch: you set up the compliance function, with direct access to the leadership team

- Real questions: work where AI, privacy and regulation meet

- A clear growth path: a buddy, monthly check-ins and room to grow the compliance function

- Continuous learning: work at an Anthropic partner, with Claude as part of your daily work

- Flexible remote work

- A team that moves fast and takes quality seriously



How to apply



IMPORTANT: We assess candidates primarily through video responses. Please do not apply without submitting a video.



Step 1: Create a short video (3 to 7 minutes)



Record yourself answering these 5 questions:



1. Tell us about yourself: Briefly introduce yourself and how you got into compliance or data privacy.

2. A process you set up: Walk us through a compliance or privacy process you documented or set up. What was missing when you started, and what did you put in place?

3. A gap you found: Tell us about a compliance or security gap you found. How did you raise it, and what happened next?

4. AI in your work: How do you use AI tools in your work today? Where would you not trust AI with compliance work?

5. Your next role: What would you like to achieve in your next role? Where do you see yourself in 5 to 10 years?



Video guidelines:

- Length: 3 to 7 minutes in total

- Production: no need for professional quality, we want to see the real you

- Authenticity: it's fine to use AI to prepare, but talk to us in your own words. Please don't read from a script.

- Language: English (this assesses your communication skills)

- Format: any video format is fine (MP4, MOV, etc.)

- Hosting: upload to Google Drive, Dropbox, YouTube (unlisted) or similar



Step 2: Submit your application



Send the following to 
 and 



1. Your video (link or attachment)

2. Your CV / resume

3. Optional: certifications, LinkedIn profile, or examples of policies or documentation you wrote (anonymized)



 subject: "Compliance Officer Application - [Your Name]"



What happens next



1. We review your video and CV within 2 to 3 days

2. If you are a strong match, we schedule an initial interview

3. Successful candidates get a short practical assignment

4. Final candidates meet with our founder

5. We aim to complete the entire process in 1 to 2 weeks



Who should apply



Apply if you:

- Want a long-term career in a high-performance organization

- Are curious about AI and how regulation shapes it



Don't apply if you:

title: Senior Video Editor: Direct Response Ads
description:
Senior Video Editor: Direct Response Ads — $3,500 to $5,000/month



Remote · Full-time · At least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time (2pm to 10pm Manila)



---



You've edited hundreds of ads. How do you know which ones worked?



Most editors cut what they're handed, send it off, and never find out. You get a brief you didn't write, for a hook you'd have done differently, and nobody tells you the result. If you only want to be handed a brief and cut it, stop here. This isn't that.



You'd be cutting for a Dubai performance creative agency working with fast-growing ecommerce and health brands on Meta and TikTok. The founders built and sold a 7-figure ecommerce brand and grew a media company to 95,000 newsletter subscribers. They run on AI and they move fast. Ally is hiring on their behalf.



---

The job



- Cut fast-paced DR ads: VSLs, UGC and creator cuts, hook stacks, AI UGC, AI explainers, animated.



- Use AI tools (avatars, voice, AI b-roll, image-to-video) to make formats a normal editor can't.



- Bring your own hooks, structures and visual concepts. They want your brain, not only your hands.



---



Your first 30 days



- You get put through intensive training. Their own courses, daily calls with the founders, feedback on everything you make, and you start writing hooks, briefs and scripts yourself.



- By the end of it you're not an editor. You're a Creative Producer.



- That means you d
 what ad gets made and why, you write the hook and the brief, you get it produced, and you read the numbers afterwards to d
 what comes next.



- And it doesn't stop there. The role grows into leading creative operations and delivery.



---



The money



$3,500 to $5,000 USD a month depending on experience, plus bonuses when your ads become winners.



It's a high number because this is three jobs in one. The craft, the AI stack, and the judgment to know why an ad converts. Most editors have one of those. A few have two.



We're hiring one person for this role now. Ally places senior editors with growing ecommerce and health brands regularly, so if you're strong and this particular one isn't the fit, we'll come to you first when the next opens.



---



You're a fit if:



- 3+ years editing paid social ads, ideally ecommerce, DR, supplements, info products or affiliates



- You can show ads that actually ran



- You've made AI UGC, AI avatar or AI-generated ads. We'll ask which tools and what they replaced



- You've picked up a new AI tool in the last few months and it changed what you can make



- Multiple ads a day doesn't scare you



- Your English is strong enough to follow scripts precisely



- You can give at least 4 hours a day overlapping 10am to 6pm Dubai time



---



You're not a fit if:



- Your portfolio is mostly brand films, weddings or vlogs



- You only want to edit and never think about why an ad works



- You need days to turn around one ad



---

What was the hook, and why that structure? What did you d ---------- yourself, and what was handed to you in the brief? How long did it run, or roughly what did it spend, if you know? What would you change now?



No Loom, no review. We watch every one.



We review every application within two working days and we reply either way.



----



About Ally



We place full-time people with founders and small teams, and we stay with you after you start: goals, reviews and growth, not just an introduction. We currently support people working with founders across Hong Kong, Dubai, the UK and Japan.

title: KDP Book Production Specialist: Formatting, AI Tools & Quality Control

Responsibilities

- Research book topics, competitors and keywords

- Very strong attention to detail, with the patience to proofread long texts carefully

- Hands-on formatting experience with Atticus, Word or similar tools

- Comfortable with AI tools, including AI image generation

- Reads instructions carefully, asks when unsure, and does not repeat the same mistake

- Works independently, takes constructive feedback well and takes ownership of errors

- Hours: 9am to 5pm UK time, Monday to Friday (currently 5pm to 1am Philippines time), camera on for calls

- Reliable internet and power backup



KDP experience is an advantage but not essential. Strong formatting and attention to detail matter most.



Shortlisted candidates complete a short, paid skills test before any offer.

Questions

title: Creative Editor
description:

How it works: for each ad you get a locked script, a recorded voice-over (or you create it from the script with an AI voice) and access to our footage bank (real UGC clips, product shots, home scenes). 

What we are looking for is someone who, from the script and the customer avatar it speaks to, immediately knows how to keep the viewer watching: strong scroll-stopping hooks, and visuals that underline every line of what is said. We are also looking for someone who finds the right shots themselves, out of our footage bank or other sources (your own sources are welcome too), or who can brief our UGC creators to film them. Monotony is the reason we are hiring.



Must-haves:



A portfolio of Meta ads that actually ran, ideally direct-response, and ideally for people over 50 (home, comfort, health, mobility), with the brands you edited for. Wedding, corporate or music video reels do not count here.



Experience sourcing footage you were not given: AI video tools, or briefing a creator for silent b-roll.



You can produce an AI voice-over yourself when we do not provide one: correct accent and age for the speaker, clean audio.



Fluent English (UK or US).



Nice to have: AI video tools, and a feel for Meta ad metrics (hook rate, thumbstop, what a first frame has to do).



How we start: a paid test project. One 60-second ad from a locked script, with a voice-over we provide or one you create, our footage bank included. Long term we are looking for someone full-time; we can talk about the rate when we get there.





To apply, please start your proposal with the word “Hook” and include:



Three links to ads you edited that ran, and one line on what you did (cut only, or sourced and directed footage too).



One example where you found or created footage that was not handed to you.



Your fixed price for a 60-second ad with three hook variants, and your usual turnaround.
